title: Acoustic Phonon Dynamics in Co-Doped BaFe$_2$As$_2$ Thin Film
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted for presentation at Frontiers in Optics + Laser Science (FiO LS 2026)
summary: Pump-probe reflectivity reveals coherent acoustic oscillations at 33 and 8.2 GHz in a Ba(Fe$_{0.92}$Co$_{0.08}$)$_2$As$_2$ thin film. The acoustic response was analyzed using a modified logistic-function model, suggesting a temporal redistribution of coherent acoustic energy consistent with anharmonic decay of the higher-frequency mode into the lower-frequency mode.

AI.tldr: 利用泵浦-探测反射率技术在Ba(Fe₀.₉₂Co₀.₀₈)₂As₂薄膜中观测到33 GHz和8.2 GHz的相干声学振荡，并通过改进的逻辑函数模型分析声学响应，揭示了高频模式向低频模式非谐衰减的能量再分布过程。
AI.motivation: 探究铁基超导体薄膜中的超快声子动力学行为，特别是相干声学振荡模式及其能量耗散机制。
AI.method: 采用泵浦-探测反射率技术测量相干声学振荡，并使用改进的逻辑函数模型对声学响应进行建模分析。
AI.result: 在Ba(Fe₀.₉₂Co₀.₀₈)₂As₂薄膜中观测到33 GHz和8.2 GHz两种相干声学振荡模式。
AI.conclusion: 高频模式通过非谐衰减过程将能量传递给低频模式，导致相干声学能量随时间重新分布。

title: Domain wall motion in a polycrystalline vortex lattice
comment: 17 pages (9 main text, 8 supplemental), 12 figures (4 main text, 8 supplemental). Replacement of arXiv:1708.03082
summary: Disorder fundamentally reshapes how crystalline systems respond to external forces, yet it remains unclear whether disorder drives interacting lattices toward glassy states or instead fragments them into domains separated by mobile interfaces. Here, we investigate vortex motion in superconducting island arrays, where disorder is introduced in a controlled manner by tuning the magnetic field away from commensurate vortex fillings. By driving vortices with an applied current, we observe a two-step depinning transition at incommensurate fillings. Comparison with molecular vortex model simulations shows that this intermediate regime is consistent with domain wall motion in a polycrystalline vortex lattice. While two-step depinning has been explored theoretically in driven periodic systems, direct experimental evidence linking this behavior to interface-dominated vortex motion has been lacking. Our results demonstrate that disordered, interacting vortex systems with strong periodic pinning can favor interface physics over homogeneous glassy dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过超导岛阵列中的涡旋运动实验，揭示了无序驱动的相互作用晶格在强周期性钉扎下更倾向于形成畴壁界面运动（多晶态），而非均匀玻璃态，并首次提供了两步脱钉转变与界面主导涡旋运动相关联的直接实验证据。
AI.motivation: 理解无序如何重塑晶体系统对外部力的响应：无序是驱动相互作用晶格进入玻璃态，还是将其分裂为由可移动界面分隔的畴。
AI.method: 在超导岛阵列中通过调节磁场偏离公度涡旋填充来可控引入无序，施加电流驱动涡旋，观测两步脱钉转变，并与分子涡旋模型模拟对比。
AI.result: 在非公度填充下观察到两步脱钉转变，模拟表明该中间态对应于多晶涡旋晶格中的畴壁运动。
AI.conclusion: 无序且相互作用的涡旋系统在强周期性钉扎下，更倾向于界面物理（畴壁运动）而非均匀玻璃态动力学。

title: Quadrature magnetoresistance scaling reflects linear field dependence rather than strange metallicity
summary: The quadrature scaling of magnetoresistance has been widely adopted as a hallmark of the strange metal state. However, whether this scaling signals quantum criticality or reflects conventional transport behavior remains controversial. Here, by systematically investigating the magnetotransport properties of NiTe2 nanosheets, we demonstrate that the quadrature scaling is not a unique signature of strange metallicity. We find that the scaling holds only when the crossover field , marking the transition from quadratic to linear magnetoresistance, is sufficiently small relative to the applied field range. Through controlled simulations, we show that the scaling emerges whenever linear magnetoresistance dominates, irrespective of its origin, and fails when the linear regime is inaccessible. This conclusion is supported by observations in SrTiO3 based heterostructures, where quadrature scaling appears despite the absence of strange metal behavior. Our results establish that the quadrature scaling merely reflects the presence of linear magneto resistance, urging caution in using this scaling as a diagnostic tool for exploring the strange metal state.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究NiTe₂纳米片和SrTiO₃异质结构，证明磁电阻的quadrature标度并非奇异金属态的特有标志，而仅仅是线性磁电阻存在的反映，提醒研究者谨慎使用这一标度作为诊断工具。
AI.motivation: quadrature标度被广泛视为奇异金属态的标志，但其是否真正反映量子临界性还是仅仅体现常规输运行为存在争议，需要澄清。
AI.method: 系统研究NiTe₂纳米片的磁输运性质，通过控制模拟展示quadrature标度在线性磁电阻主导时出现、线性区域不可达时消失的规律，并在SrTiO₃异质结构中进行验证。
AI.result: quadrature标度仅当线性磁电阻主导时成立，与是否奇异金属态无关；在SrTiO₃异质结构中也观察到该标度，但其并非奇异金属。
AI.conclusion: quadrature标度只是线性磁电阻存在的反映，不能作为奇异金属态的诊断工具，需谨慎使用。

title: Incommensurate modulation with $Q=0$ A-type Antiferromagnetic Order in CeRh$_2$As$_2$ revealed by NQR studies
summary: We performed $^{75}$As nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements on a higher-quality single-crystalline CeRh$_2$As$_2$, a heavy-fermion superconductor exhibiting multiple superconducting (SC) phases under magnetic fields along the $c$ axis. This SC multiphase is believed to originate from staggered Rashba spin-orbit coupling associated with locally broken inversion symmetry. In addition to superconductivity, CeRh$_2$As$_2$ exhibits phase I below $T_0\sim0.5$ K and an antiferromagnetic (AFM) state below $T_{N}\sim 0.25$ K in the early-stage samples. In the higher-quality sample, the AFM transition becomes more pronounced, and $T_{N}$ increases to nearly coincide with $T_{SC}$. The NQR spectra at the As(1) site imply an internal field with an incommensurate distribution, indicating a two-dimensional incommensurate modulation of the magnetic structure superimposed on a $Q=0$ A-type AFM component. Moreover, a pronounced decrease in the NQR intensity at $T_0$ well-above $T_{N}$ and an abrupt increase in the internal field at $T_{N}$ suggest the emergence of a slowly fluctuating AFM order at $T_0$ which becomes static at $T_{N}$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过核四极共振（NQR）和核磁共振（NMR）测量，研究了高质量CeRh₂As₂单晶中多种超导相与磁性序的关联，发现非公度二维磁调制叠加在Q=0 A型反铁磁分量上，并在T₀处出现慢涨落反铁磁序，最终在T_N处锁定为静态。
AI.motivation: 探究CeRh₂As₂中因局部反演对称性破缺导致的交错Rashba自旋轨道耦合所引发的多重超导相，及其与磁有序（相I和反铁磁态）之间的相互作用关系。
AI.method: 在高质量CeRh₂As₂单晶上开展⁷⁵As核四极共振（NQR）和核磁共振（NMR）测量，通过分析As(1)位点的NQR谱、强度及内场变化，表征磁结构及其涨落行为。
AI.result: 高质量样品中反铁磁转变更明显，T_N升高至接近T_SC；NQR谱显示内场具有非公度分布，表明存在二维非公度磁调制叠加在Q=0 A型反铁磁分量上；T₀处NQR强度显著下降，T_N处内场突增，揭示慢涨落反铁磁序在T₀出现、在T_N变为静态。
AI.conclusion: CeRh₂As₂中反铁磁序与超导序存在紧密关联，磁性结构的非公度调制和分步有序过程（涨落→静态）是理解其多重超导相的关键。

title: Position: The Inevitable Transition to Machine Learning in Quantum Chemistry
comment: Accepted as a position paper at ICML 2026. OpenReview forum: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Mq1oTEIwp4
summary: Finding exact solutions to the quantum many-body problem is computationally intractable (QMA-hard). Traditional approximations for electrons in an atom or molecule -- density functional theory and wavefunction methods -- have been indispensable, but their development shows signs of saturation: DFT functionals have proliferated without converging toward the exact functional, and strong correlation remains largely unsolved after decades of effort. This position paper argues that machine learning represents the most promising path forward -- not as a proof of logical necessity, but as a decision-theoretic argument: ML succeeds whether the underlying problems are truly hard or merely lack simple analytical solutions. We reframe recent traditional method development as ``hand-crafted machine learning'' that has exhausted the hypothesis space accessible to human intuition. Significant challenges remain, but these have clear research paths forward, unlike the fundamental barriers facing traditional approaches. ML-based approaches merit strategic priority in quantum chemistry's next phase.

AI.tldr: 本文论证机器学习是解决量子多体问题最有前景的路径，认为传统方法（DFT和波函数方法）已接近发展瓶颈，而ML方法能够突破人类直觉限制，应成为量子化学下一阶段的战略重点。
AI.motivation: 量子多体问题的精确求解在计算上是难解的（QMA-hard），传统近似方法（如DFT和波函数方法）虽然在历史上不可或缺，但已显现发展饱和迹象——DFT泛函不断泛滥却未能收敛到精确泛函，强关联问题经过数十年努力仍未解决。作者旨在提出ML作为突破这一困境的可行路径。
AI.method: 本文为观点论文（position paper），通过决策论论证（decision-theoretic argument）而非逻辑必然性证明来支持ML路径：无论底层问题是真正困难还是仅仅缺乏简单的解析解，ML都能成功。作者将传统方法发展重新框架为"手工制作的机器学习"，认为这些方法已耗尽了人类直觉可达的假设空间。
AI.result: 识别出传统方法的根本性障碍：DFT泛函不收敛于精确泛函，强关联问题长期未解。指出ML方法虽仍有挑战，但这些挑战有清晰的研究路径，而传统方法面临的是根本性障碍。
AI.conclusion: ML方法应获得量子化学下一阶段的战略优先地位。传统方法已触及人类直觉的天花板，而ML能够探索更广阔的假设空间，是推进量子化学最有希望的方向。

title: Isochoric thermodynamic preconditioning for resolving mechanically induced phase change in fractured porous media
summary: Rapid pore-volume changes can trigger phase change on timescales shorter than characteristic transport times and may therefore be skipped by conventional nonlinear solves and adaptive time stepping. We present a persistent-variable framework for transport in fractured porous media, introducing specific volume as an independent variable. Starting from a fully coupled system, we derive volume-based models and recover classical pressure-based formulations by eliminating local thermodynamic variables. To resolve abrupt fracture opening, we introduce a nonlinear preconditioner that assumes instantaneous free expansion and resolves the fluid state through an isochoric equilibrium calculation before advancing the transport problem. The preconditioner applies to both volume- and pressure-based models. In the studied fracture-opening cases, unpreconditioned simulations miss transient vaporization, whereas the preconditioned models do not. Across the investigated aperture range, larger openings produce monotonic increases in gas content, expansion-induced cooling, and durations of transients. Thermal effects alter the phase evolution but have otherwise minor influence on the overall transient duration. Within the proof-of-concept setting, fracture opening generates substantial transient pressure reductions, indicating that geomechanical feedback may become important in fully coupled applications. Pressure-enthalpy and volume-temperature formulations recover identical physical solutions but exhibit different nonlinear robustness, with the pressure-enthalpy formulation proving more robust in some recompression-dominated cases. These results show that equilibrium specifications control the numerical properties of the nonlinear problem rather than recovered physical responses, while isochoric preconditioning connects the nonlinear initialization directly to the underlying thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对裂缝多孔介质输运的持久变量框架，将比体积作为独立变量，并引入非线性预条件器来处理裂缝快速张开引发的瞬态相变问题。研究表明预条件模型能捕捉无预条件模型遗漏的瞬态汽化现象，且压力-焓与体积-温度公式虽物理解相同但非线性鲁棒性不同。
AI.motivation: 快速孔隙体积变化可在短于特征输运时间的时间尺度上触发相变，传统非线性求解器和自适应时间步长可能跳过这些瞬态过程，需要新的数值框架来捕捉这一物理现象。
AI.method: 提出持久变量框架，引入比体积作为独立变量；从全耦合系统出发推导基于体积的模型，并通过消除局部热力学变量恢复经典压力基公式；针对裂缝突然张开引入非线性预条件器，假设瞬时自由膨胀并通过等容平衡计算确定流体状态，再推进输运问题。
AI.result: 无预条件模拟遗漏瞬态汽化，预条件模型则成功捕捉；更大开度产生气体含量单调增加、膨胀致冷和瞬态持续时间延长；热效应改变相演化但对整体瞬态持续时间影响较小；裂缝张开产生显著瞬态压降；压力-焓与体积-温度公式物理解相同，但压力-焓公式在再压缩主导情况下更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 平衡规格决定非线性问题的数值性质而非恢复的物理响应，等容预条件将非线性初始化与底层热力学直接联系起来。在完全耦合应用中，地力学反馈可能变得重要。

title: Exotic Electronic Order in a Parabolic Kagome Semimetal
summary: We study an interacting kagome-lattice realization of a quadratic band-touching semimetal at 2/3 filling with onsite and nearest-neighbor repulsive interactions. Combining functional renormalization group and slave-boson approaches, we map its phase diagram from intermediate to strong coupling and uncover a hierarchy of unconventional electronic orders. The leading instabilities comprise loop-current order, spontaneous altermagnetism arising from a spin-Pomeranchuk instability, and spin-loop-current order with distinctive and largely unexplored properties. We demonstrate how the interplay of band kinematics, electronic interactions, and quantum geometry governs the selection of these phases. Our findings establish quadratic band-touching semimetals as a promising platform for unconventional symmetry breaking and suggest analogous phenomena in other parabolic semimetals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究kagome晶格上2/3填充的二次能带接触半金属，通过结合fRG和slave-boson方法发现其在中强耦合下存在环流序、自发交错磁性和自旋环流序等非传统电子序，揭示了能带运动学、电子相互作用和量子几何对相选择的共同作用。
AI.motivation: 探索二次能带接触半金属中非传统对称性破缺的可能性，理解能带运动学、相互作用和量子几何如何协同决定新奇电子序的形成。
AI.method: 结合功能重正化群(fRG)和奴隶玻色子(slave-boson)方法，从中等耦合到强耦合区域绘制相图。
AI.result: 发现了三种主导不稳定性：环流序(loop-current order)、自发交错磁性(spontaneous altermagnetism，源于自旋Pomeranchuk不稳定性)以及自旋环流序(spin-loop-current order)。
AI.conclusion: 二次能带接触半金属是实现非传统对称性破缺的有前景平台，相关现象可能存在于其他抛物线型半金属中。

title: Sound Induced Hall Currents in Weyl Exciton Insulators
summary: Weyl semimetals exhibit anomalous transport controlled by their gapless chiral nodes, while gapped Weyl systems are often expected to lose such distinctive responses. Here we show that Weyl excitonic insulators instead host a new form of axial-field-driven transport that exists only in the massive phase. Starting from the low-energy Breit-type Hamiltonian for a gapped Weyl system coupled to strain-induced axial potentials, we develop a semiclassical wave-packet theory and identify a dissipative transverse current generated by a dynamical axial potential. This response is qualitatively distinct from both ordinary vector-potential transport in gapped systems and axial responses in gapless Weyl semimetals. Physically, it originates from a mass-induced Berry structure of the reconstructed Weyl bands, which becomes active when the system is driven out of equilibrium by a chiral chemical-potential imbalance. We show that transverse sound waves provide a natural route to generate the required dynamical axial field and estimate the resulting current for realistic material parameters. Our results reveal sound-induced Hall transport as a direct probe of Weyl excitonic order and provide a transport signature of interaction-generated mass in Weyl materials.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Weyl激子绝缘体在带隙相中能产生一种由轴向场驱动的新型输运现象——声致横向电流，该效应源于质量诱导的Berry曲率结构，可用于探测Weyl材料中的相互作用生成质量。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为带隙的Weyl系统会失去手性节点带来的反常输运特性，作者试图探究在Weyl激子绝缘体中是否可能存在新的输运机制。
AI.method: 从耦合应变诱导轴向势的带隙Weyl系统低能Breit型哈密顿量出发，发展半经典波包理论，分析动力学轴向势产生的耗散性横向电流。
AI.result: 发现带隙Weyl系统中存在一种全新的轴向场驱动横向输运，该响应与普通矢量势输运和无带隙Weyl半金属的轴向响应定性不同，来源于质量诱导的Berry结构重构，在手性化学势不平衡时激活。
AI.conclusion: 横向声波可产生所需动力学轴向场，声致Hall输运可直接探测Weyl激子序，为Weyl材料中相互作用生成质量提供输运特征。

title: Towards a universal model for spin-orbit coupled Wannier Hamiltonians
summary: While machine learning interatomic potentials (MLiPs) have matured to revolutionize material science, deep learning models for electronic structure are just beginning to emerge and restricted, almost exclusively, to non-orthogonal basis Hamiltonians. We introduce G(Wa)NN, the first deep-learning model capable of generating the electronic Hamiltonian of solid-state systems in an orthogonal Wannier basis. G(Wa)NN is trained on an unprecedented, diverse dataset of more than 111K Wannier Hamiltonians (150M+ hopping matrices) spanning 69 elements. The combination of optimized inference and linear-scaling methods for orthogonal Hamiltonians unlock transport simulations at massive scales (10K+ atoms). Crucially, the framework supports local finetuning, allowing users to adapt the base model to custom Wannier Hamiltonian datasets. To seamlessly translate these predictions into physical observables, we introduce Tailwater, a Python package providing an API interface to G(Wa)NN alongside a high performance post-processing library. Tailwater enables automated projection of the predicted Hamiltonian into an arbitrary low-energy subspace-directly mirroring familiar Wannier90 workflows-and includes a suite of Kernel Polynomial Method (KPM) functions that exploit the orthogonal basis to achieve strict linear scaling for spectral observables. The Tailwater ecosystem, with the G(Wa)NN model at its core, aims to help bridge the gap between deep learning and macro-scale quantum transport simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G(Wa)NN，首个能生成正交Wannier基下电子哈密顿量的深度学习模型，基于111K+个Wannier哈密顿量训练，结合线性标度方法实现万原子级输运模拟，并配套Tailwater工具包用于后处理与物理量计算。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习电子结构模型几乎仅限于非正交基哈密顿量，缺乏能生成正交Wannier基哈密顿量的方法，限制了大尺度量子输运模拟的发展。
AI.method: 提出G(Wa)NN深度学习模型，在111K+个Wannier哈密顿量（150M+跳迁矩阵）上训练，覆盖69种元素；采用优化推理与正交哈密顿量线性标度方法；支持局部微调；配套Tailwater工具包实现自动低能子空间投影和KPM谱函数计算。
AI.result: 实现了万原子以上规模的输运模拟；模型在多样化数据集上训练，具备泛化能力；Tailwater工具包提供了从预测到可观测量计算的完整流程。
AI.conclusion: G(Wa)NN与Tailwater生态填补了深度学习与宏尺度量子输运模拟之间的空白，为大规模电子结构计算提供了新的可行范式。

title: Information Compression at Criticality
summary: Highly excited quantum states at the critical boundary of ergodicity are known to deviate from thermal behavior, yet their dynamical properties remain poorly understood. Here, we uncover the complexity of quantum dynamics at criticality through the lens of intrinsic information compression in energy space. We show that the Hamiltonian spectrum can be systematically truncated, yielding a simplified description of the dynamics while preserving its essential features. Specifically, for both interacting and noninteracting systems, we demonstrate that a vanishing fraction of Hamiltonian eigenlevels suffices to reproduce the power-law decay of the survival probability. The resulting truncated spectrum exhibits a fractal structure characterized by a level-spacing distribution with a power-law tail, while its spectral form factor displays the same asymptotic power-law decay as the survival probability.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在遍历性临界边界上的高度激发量子态，可以通过在能量空间中进行信息压缩——即截断哈密顿量本征能级——来简化描述。研究表明，仅需极小部分本征能级即可再现存活概率的幂律衰减行为，且截断后的谱呈现分形结构。
AI.motivation: 高度激发量子态处于遍历性临界边界时偏离热行为，但其动力学性质尚不清晰，作者希望通过能量空间中的信息压缩来揭示临界态量子动力学的复杂性。
AI.method: 对哈密顿量能谱进行系统性截断，保留极少数本征能级以简化动力学描述，同时通过存活概率的幂律衰减、能级间距分布的幂律尾以及谱型因子等指标检验截断谱的有效性。
AI.result: 对于相互作用和非相互作用系统，仅需极小比例的本征能级即可重现存活概率的幂律衰减；截断后的谱呈分形结构，能级间距分布具有幂律尾，且谱型因子的渐近幂律衰减与存活概率一致。
AI.conclusion: 临界量子动力学可以通过能量空间的压缩（谱截断）得到有效描述，截断谱的分形特性揭示了临界态的内在复杂性。

title: Self-consistent GW theory for superconductivity in SrTiO3 models
summary: Superconductivity in doped SrTiO$_3$ occurs over a wide range of carrier densities, including those for which the Fermi energy is below the polar longitudinal optical phonon scale. In this regime, the assumptions underpinning conventional implementations of Migdal-Eliashberg theory, including frequency cutoffs at the phonon scale and a Coulomb pseudopotential $μ^\ast$, are not valid. We solve the finite-temperature $GW$ equations with full momentum and frequency dependence, without cutoffs or $μ^\ast$, for polar one-band models of SrTiO$_3$, using effective masses and three-phonon dielectric functions parameterized from ab initio calculations. Comparing different self-consistency levels, namely $G_0W_0$, $GW_0$, and fully self-consistent $GW$, we find that the one-shot ($G_0W_0$) kernel overestimates the pairing-onset temperature by one to two orders of magnitude. The dominant suppression comes from replacing $G_0$ by $G$, thereby incorporating the phonon renormalization factor in the electron Green function. Using the self-consistently computed interaction $W$ further lowers and narrows the pairing-onset dome. In the dilute limit, our calculations identify the pairing channel as the Fröhlich phonon interaction screened by the incipient ferroelectricity of the material, with plasmonic and electronic screening effects negligible. The numerical solution of the full equations reveals a pairing-onset scale that remains non-zero as the density tends to zero, whereas Fermi-surface projection or Fermi-energy frequency truncation removes it. This work highlights the relevance of incipient ferroelectricity, the importance of self-consistency, and the need for a full momentum- and frequency-dependent treatment in modeling superconductivity in SrTiO$_3$-like doped polar semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全动量-频率依赖的有限温度GW方程（无截断或μ*），研究了掺杂SrTiO₃中的超导配对机制。发现一次自洽（G₀W₀）会高估配对温度1-2个数量级，而完全自洽GW结果揭示：稀极限下配对由Fröhlich声子与初期铁电性屏蔽主导，且配对尺度在密度趋零时仍非零，这对理解掺杂极性半导体超导有重要意义。
AI.motivation: 在掺杂SrTiO₃中，费米能低于极性纵向光学声子能标的载流子密度区域内，传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论（包含声子尺度频率截断和库仑赝势μ*）的假设不再成立。因此需要无截断、无μ*的全动量-频率依赖处理方法，以正确描述该体系的超导配对机制。
AI.method: 采用全动量-频率依赖的有限温度GW方程（无截断或μ*），针对SrTiO₃的极性单带模型，结合从第一性原理参数化的有效质量和三声子介电函数，分别在G₀W₀、GW₀和完全自洽GW三个自洽层级上求解，并分析配对起始温度。
AI.result: (1) G₀W₀高估配对起始温度1-2个数量级；(2) 主要抑制来自用G替换G₀（引入声子重整化因子）；(3) 自洽W进一步降低并收窄配对穹顶；(4) 稀极限下配对通道为被初期铁电性屏蔽的Fröhlich声子，等离子体和电子屏蔽效应可忽略；(5) 配对尺度在密度趋零时非零，但费米面投影或费米能频率截断会消除此行为。
AI.conclusion: 强调了初期铁电性、自洽性以及全动量-频率依赖处理在模拟SrTiO₃类掺杂极性半导体超导中的关键作用，并指出传统近似方法（如费米面投影或频率截断）会丢失重要的物理行为。

title: Uncertainty quantification in mechanics: A unified Bayesian perspective
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential to experimental mechanics, but has become particularly relevant in computational mechanics, manifesting in two fundamental problem types: forward and inverse problems. The former addresses how input uncertainties propagate to the quantities of interest, whereas the latter aims to infer unknown parameters from experimental observations or simulations. Since efficient propagation typically requires a prohibitive number of evaluations to compute marginal output distributions, the development of fast, data-driven surrogate models becomes necessary. Thus, we can distinguish between two inverse tasks: (i) the identification and calibration of input uncertainties, and (ii) the construction of surrogates, a methodology collectively referred to as surrogate-based UQ. Building on probabilistic reasoning and the concept of partial belief, we demonstrate that Bayesian probability theory provides a unified theoretical framework for addressing both problem types. We further show that Bayesian inference allows for the seamless incorporation of essential subproblems, including model selection for identifying the most probable model specifications and experimental design for optimizing data collection by identifying experiments or simulations that maximize expected information gain about parameters, among others such as connections to sensitivity analysis or the use of special priors like random fields. While this theoretical framework is presented for general mechanical problems, particular emphasis is placed on biomechanics, where variability and uncertainty is especially pronounced due to inherent biological heterogeneity, patient-specific variability, and noisy data.

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了贝叶斯概率论作为替代模型不确定性量化（UQ）的统一理论框架，涵盖前向传播与逆向推断两类问题，并以生物力学为典型应用场景，展示了模型选择、实验设计、敏感性分析等子问题的无缝整合。
AI.motivation: 实验与计算力学中不确定性量化至关重要，但高效传播需要大量计算，驱动了快速数据驱动替代模型的发展。亟需一个统一的理论框架来整合前向问题（不确定性传播）与两类逆向任务（输入不确定性标定、替代模型构建）。
AI.method: 基于贝叶斯概率论与部分信念（partial belief）概念，提出统一的概率推理框架，将替代模型构建、模型选择、实验设计、敏感性分析、随机场先验等子问题统一纳入贝叶斯推断体系。
AI.result: 贝叶斯概率论能够统一处理两类不确定性问题（前向传播与逆向推断），并自然融合模型选择（识别最可能的模型规格）和实验设计（最大化参数信息增益）等关键子问题。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯框架为力学（尤其是生物力学）中的替代模型不确定性量化提供了统一的理论基础，特别适用于生物力学中因生物异质性、患者特异性变异和噪声数据导致的不确定性突出场景。

title: Non-Fermi-Liquid Behaviors in Weakly Interacting Two-Dimensional Quasicrystals
summary: Non-Fermi-liquid (NFL) behavior is usually associated with strong electronic correlations, quantum criticality, or singular fluctuations that invalidate the quasiparticle picture. Quasicrystals are known to provide a fundamentally different route to such physics: their lack of translational symmetry gives rise to critical single-particle states and fragmented spectra even in the absence of electron-electron interactions. Here, we numerically study the NFL behaviors in quasicrystals with weak interactions. Using Penrose and Ammann--Beenker tilings as representative quasiperiodic systems, we analyze thermodynamic, magnetic, and transport properties within a weak-coupling perturbative framework. The Sommerfeld coefficient and magnetic susceptibility show anomalous temperature dependences governed by the singular energy dependence of the density of states near the Fermi level. The Wilson ratio reveals that low-temperature NFL behavior in quasicrystals is accompanied by enhanced spin fluctuations over a broad range of filling fractions, while its magnitude and temperature dependence vary sensitively with filling fraction. The self-energy shows anomalous scaling and a finite residual scattering rate, indicating the breakdown of quasiparticles. Our site-resolved analysis reveals a pronounced enhancement of the residual scattering rate in regions with a high local density of states. These results serve as a guide to analyze experimental data for quasicrystals and to identify the microscopic mechanism of the NFL behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过弱耦合微扰框架，数值研究了Penrose和Ammann-Beenker拼图准晶中的非费米液体行为，发现其热力学、磁性和输运性质呈现反常温度依赖，并揭示了准粒子破坏与局域态密度增强的关联。
AI.motivation: 准晶因缺乏平移对称性导致单粒子态临界和谱破碎，即使无电子-电子相互作用也能产生非费米液体行为。本文旨在探索弱相互作用下准晶中NFL行为的微观机制，为实验数据分析提供指导。
AI.method: 以Penrose和Ammann-Beenker拼图为代表性准周期系统，在弱耦合微扰框架下数值研究热力学、磁性和输运性质，并开展位点分辨分析。
AI.result: 索末菲系数和磁化率呈现由态密度奇异能量依赖支配的反常温度依赖；Wilson比显示低温NFL行为伴随增强的自旋涨落，但其幅度和温度依赖对填充率敏感；自能呈现反常标度和有限残余散射率，表明准粒子破坏；位点分辨分析显示残余散射率在局域态密度高的区域显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 准晶在弱相互作用下即可产生非费米液体行为，其根源在于准周期结构导致的奇异态密度，该研究为理解实验数据和识别NFL行为的微观机制提供了指导。

title: Probing Synthetic Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon States Through Critical Current in Full-Shell Nanowire Josephson Junctions
comment: 5 pages (main) + 2 pages (End Matter) + 4 pages (Supp. Mat.). 3 + 6 figures
summary: Full-shell hybrid nanowires consisting of a semiconductor core fully enveloped by a superconducting shell have emerged as a platform to study Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon (CdGM) analogs. These subgap states can be considered a synthetic version of CdGM states in Abrikosov vortices. Unlike conventional CdGM states, these analogs exhibit a level spacing comparable to the superconducting gap, making them readily observable via tunneling spectroscopy techniques. The spectral density of CdGM analogs follows a characteristic skewed pattern as a function of applied axial magnetic field, an effect that is superimposed on the Little-Parks oscillations of the shell's gap induced by fluxoid quantization. Here, we provide experimental evidence for CdGM analogs through a distinctive skewness fingerprint in the critical current and zero-bias resistance of overdamped Josephson junctions based on full-shell nanowires.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全壳混合纳米线中Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon (CdGM)类似态的特性，通过过阻尼Josephson结中的临界电流和零偏电阻的不对称特征，提供了CdGM类似态的实验证据。
AI.motivation: 实验验证全壳纳米线中CdGM类似态的存在，此前这些态仅在理论上被预测或通过隧道谱间接观测。
AI.method: 基于全壳纳米线构建过阻尼Josephson结，测量临界电流和零偏电阻在轴向磁场下的响应，分析其不对称特征。
AI.result: 在临界电流和零偏电阻中观测到与CdGM类似态对应的独特不对称特征，该特征叠加在Little-Parks振荡之上。
AI.conclusion: 全壳混合纳米线中的CdGM类似态可通过输运测量直接实验验证，为研究这类新型子带隙态提供了可行途径。

title: Electron escape probability in high-efficiency photocathodes measured by reverse-injection photovoltage
summary: The characterization of electron transfer through the emitting surface is of crucial importance for optimizing existing and developing new photocathodes. Here we propose and develop a method for the direct determination of the electron escape probability in high-efficiency semiconductor photocathodes. The proposed method is based on the variations in the surface photovoltage upon the injection of emitted photoelectrons back into a photocathode (``reverse injection"), which is induced by the polarity reversal of the external electric field. We demonstrate the method on \textit{p}-GaN(Cs,O) photocathodes with negative effective electron affinity by measuring the evolution of photoemission quantum efficiency upon the reverse injection of emitted electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并演示了一种通过反向注入发射电子直接测定高效半导体光电阴极中电子逃逸概率的新方法，并以p-GaN(Cs,O)负电子亲和势光电阴极为例进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 表征通过发射表面的电子转移对于优化现有和开发新型光电阴极至关重要，但缺乏直接测定电子逃逸概率的有效方法。
AI.method: 基于外电场极性反转导致发射光电子反向注入光电阴极时表面光电压的变化，通过测量反向注入前后光发射量子效率的演变来测定电子逃逸概率。
AI.result: 成功在p-GaN(Cs,O)负有效电子亲和势光电阴极上演示了该方法，验证了其可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该直接测定方法为优化现有光电阴极及开发新型高效光电阴极提供了重要工具。

title: Absence of hidden analytic conserved quantities in harmonically confined rods
summary: Systems of hard rods of equal length in a one-dimensional harmonic trap have been observed to exhibit peculiar non-ergodic behavior that might suggest the existence of a novel hidden conserved quantity beyond the two well known ones, i.e., the total energy and the center-of-mass energy. In this work, we investigate this possibility by systematically constraining the forms of the conserved quantities, and we rigorously rule out the existence of any extra hidden conserved quantity that is analytic in the positions and momenta of the rods involved. We do so by showing two key results: conservation during free motion demands the $U(1)$ invariance of these quantities under rotations of the position and momenta of each rod, and conservation during collisions demand an $S_N$ invariance under the permutation of the momenta of the rods as long as one of the rods have non-zero length. We then show that these conditions imply that any conserved quantity is functionally dependent on the two known conserved quantities. In addition, we show that in the special case where all rods have zero length (i.e., when they are point particles), conservation under collisions only requires invariance under a smaller $S_N$ group of permutations of the labels of the rods, which leads to a much larger set of analytic conserved quantities that we explicitly write down. In all, this rigorously clarifies the structure of conserved quantities in the hard rod problem, and motivates the application of such systematic methods to other classical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过严格的数学分析，证明了一维谐振子陷阱中硬棒系统不存在除了总能量和质心能量之外的其他解析守恒量，澄清了此前关于该系统可能具有隐藏守恒量的猜测。
AI.motivation: 一维谐振子陷阱中的等长硬棒系统表现出奇特的非遍历行为，暗示可能存在除总能量和质心能量之外的隐藏守恒量。作者希望系统性地探究这种可能性，严格证明或证伪隐藏守恒量的存在。
AI.method: 通过系统地约束守恒量的形式，分别从自由运动和碰撞过程两个角度推导守恒条件。自由运动要求守恒量对每个杆的位置和动量具有U(1)旋转不变性；碰撞过程要求当杆有非零长度时，守恒量在动量置换下具有S_N对称性。作者证明这两个条件共同迫使任何守恒量都只能依赖于两个已知的守恒量。此外，还分析了零长度（质点）这一特殊情形。
AI.result: 严格证明了不存在任何解析的隐藏守恒量。具体地：(1) 对于非零长度的硬棒，任何解析守恒量都功能依赖于总能量和质心能量；(2) 对于零长度的质点，仅需在更小的S_N置换群下不变，从而存在大量额外的解析守恒量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作严格澄清了硬棒问题中守恒量的结构，解释了此前观察到的非遍历行为并非源于隐藏守恒量，并提出了可推广到其他经典系统的系统性方法。

title: Collective modes in non-Hermitian fermionic superfluids
summary: The Higgs and Nambu-Goldstone modes are paradigmatic collective excitations in superconductors and superfluids. These modes are commonly analyzed within the pseudospin formulation of BCS theory, where the dynamics are obtained from the Heisenberg equations of motion for pseudospins. However, this construction becomes inconsistent when directly extended to non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we develop a consistent pseudospin framework for non-Hermitian fermionic superfluids based on the metricized formulation of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics. We apply this formalism to a driven non-Hermitian BCS-type Hamiltonian with complex pairing interaction and analyze its collective excitation spectrum. We find that, in addition to the conventional Higgs (amplitude) mode, the system hosts a novel phase mode that has no counterpart in Hermitian superfluids. Remarkably, this mode is gapped even in the absence of the Anderson-Higgs mechanism, as is the case in neutral superfluids. Furthermore, the resonance spectrum depends explicitly on the initial nongauge phase of the complex order parameter and the dynamical response remains finite at resonance, in contrast to the divergence characteristic of Hermitian systems. These resonances disappear upon the emergence of exceptional points.

AI.tldr: 本文为非厄米费米子超流体发展了一套基于度规化的赝自旋框架，发现了一种在厄米超流体中不存在的新型有隙相位模式，其共振谱依赖于复数序参数的初始非规范相位，且在共振时响应有限而非发散。
AI.motivation: 传统的BCS赝自旋方法在直接推广到非厄米系统时会变得不自洽，因此需要为非厄米费米子超流体建立一致的赝自旋理论框架。
AI.method: 基于度规化的非厄米量子力学形式，为具有复配对相互作用的驱动非厄米BCS型哈密顿量建立自洽的赝自旋框架，并分析其集体激发谱。
AI.result: 发现了新型有隙相位模式（不同于厄米超流体中的零能Nambu-Goldstone模）；共振谱依赖于初始非规范相位；响应在共振时有限而非发散；在出现奇异点时共振消失。
AI.conclusion: 非厄米超流体中存在厄米系统所没有的独特集体激发模式，其物理性质（如共振行为、相依赖性）与传统超流体有本质区别。

title: Random site percolation with complex neighborhoods in five dimension
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures (plus 2 figures in supplemental material), 2 source codes in C++ (in supplemental material)
summary: In this paper, the random site percolation problem in a five-dimensional space for complex neighborhoods is studied. The efficient C++ code (with ordinary work division) of the classical Newman--Ziff algorithm is presented. The obtained speed-up of computations reduces 2170 years of single-core computations -- necessary for obtaining the results presented in this paper -- much below the typical half-decay time of the scientist. For complex neighborhoods, it is for neighborhoods composed with sites taken from several coordination zones (up to the seventh coordination zone), the 127 percolation thresholds are calculated (with 120 among them being estimated for the first time). For seven extended (compact) neighborhoods, the fractal dimensions are also calculated. The mean value of these fractal dimensions, averaged over these seven compact neighborhoods, is estimated as $\langle d_f\rangle\approx 3.5581(70)$. The percentage errors of the values obtained for the fractal dimensions for compact neighborhoods vary from 0.26\% to 1.76\% with respect to the theoretically predicted value based on scaling relations and the most recent estimates of critical exponents for five-dimensional space. The universality of the percolation threshold as dependent on the weighted coordination number $ζ=\sum_i z_i r_i$ (where $z_i$ is the number of sites in the $i$-th coordination zone and $r_i$ is the Euclidean distance from the sites in the $i$-th coordination zone to the central site) is also verified. The latter manifests itself as the power law ($p_c\proptoζ^{-g}$) with $g\approx 0.7913(43)$

AI.tldr: 本文通过高效的Newman-Ziff算法并行计算，研究了五维空间中复杂邻域的随机位点渗流问题，首次估算了120个渗流阈值，并验证了渗流阈值的普适性规律。
AI.motivation: 五维空间中复杂邻域的渗流问题在理论上具有重要意义，但计算量极大（单核需2170年），因此需要高效的算法和并行计算来实现这一研究。
AI.method: 采用经典的Newman-Ziff算法，通过C++代码实现普通工作划分的并行计算，对多达第七配位层的复杂邻域进行随机位点渗流模拟，计算渗流阈值和分形维数。
AI.result: 计算了127个渗流阈值（其中120个首次估算），对7个紧致邻域计算了分形维数，其平均值约为3.5581(70)，与理论值的误差在0.26%-1.76%之间；验证了渗流阈值与加权配位数ζ之间的幂律关系，指数g≈0.7913(43)。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的并行算法大幅降低了计算时间，使五维复杂邻域渗流研究成为可能；获得的渗流阈值和分形维数与理论预测一致，验证了渗流阈值的普适性规律。

title: Quantum critical fan and emergent relativistic symmetry of two-dimensional Dirac semimetals
summary: Two-dimensional Dirac semimetals near a quantum critical point can be described by Gross--Neveu--Yukawa models. In view of recent experimental advances exhibiting a transition from Dirac semimetal to insulator in highly-tunable van-der-Waals heterostructures, a better understanding of finite-temperature effects is mandatory. Here, we study the Gross--Neveu--Yukawa phase diagram of the chiral Ising model with a non-perturbative field-theory approach at zero and finite temperature, both in the semimetallic phase and in the insulating phase with spontaneously broken $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry. At zero temperature, we find a quantum critical point with critical exponents that are close to the ones of the chiral Ising universality class, and show that relativistic symmetry is emergent close to the quantum critical point. At finite temperature, the ordered phase survives up to a finite critical temperature, at which we observe a classical phase transition into the disordered phase. We confirm that this transition lies in the two-dimensional Ising universality class. Finally, we determine the extent and scaling properties of the quantum critical fan, and the behavior of the quasiparticle weight, therein. In summary, we present a unified field-theoretical framework for the phase diagram of the chiral Ising model in the surroundings of its quantum critical point.

AI.tldr: 本文采用非微扰场论方法，系统研究了手性Ising模型在零温和有限温下的Gross-Neveu-Yukawa相图，包括半金属相和绝缘相，确定了量子临界点、经典相变及量子临界扇区的标度性质。
AI.motivation: 随着实验上在范德瓦尔斯异质结中观测到狄拉克半金属到绝缘体的转变，理解有限温度效应变得迫切，但目前缺乏对相关量子临界点附近温度效应的系统理论描述。
AI.method: 采用非微扰场论方法（functional renormalization group）研究手性Ising模型的Gross-Neveu-Yukawa相图，分别在零温（量子临界点）和有限温（经典临界点）下进行分析。
AI.result: 零温时发现量子临界点，其临界指数接近手性Ising普适类，且相对论对称性在临界点附近涌现；有限温时有序相持续到有限临界温度，该经典相变属于二维Ising普适类；确定了量子临界扇区的范围和标度性质以及准粒子权重的行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为手性Ising模型在量子临界点附近的相图建立了统一的场论框架，对理解二维狄拉克半金属的量子临界现象和有限温行为具有重要意义。

title: Fragile Topology is Unstable Under Translation Refinement
summary: Fragile topological phases become trivial upon the addition of suitable trivial bands, distinguishing them from stable topological phases. Nevertheless, various response phenomena and material realizations have been proposed for fragile phases. At the same time, many of these phenomena can also occur in atomic insulators, leaving open the question of what properties are specific to fragile phases. Enlarging the unit cell offers a natural perspective on this question. Band folding increases the number of bands in a manner analogous to adding trivial bands. In this work, we establish a systematic framework for determining the stability of fragile topology under unit-cell enlargement. We first establish a systematic criterion for trivialization under enlargements compatible with space-group symmetry, grounded in a physical electron-positron picture and formulated through a Hilbert-basis analysis of momentum-space symmetry data. We then show that, for all two-dimensional wallpaper groups, with or without spin-orbit coupling and/or time-reversal symmetry, every symmetry-indicated fragile phase is adiabatically connected to an atomic insulator in a suitable finite supercell and can therefore be trivialized by an arbitrarily small symmetry-preserving perturbation. Our results reveal that fragile topology has only finite stability under translation-symmetry refinement. This highlights that the fate of a fragile phase can depend on translation-symmetry-breaking perturbations, such as charge-density-wave ordering, and suggests that physical signatures insensitive to translation refinement are unlikely to uniquely characterize fragile topology.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了脆弱拓扑相在晶胞扩大下的稳定性，发现所有对称性指示的脆弱拓扑相在有限超胞中都可绝热连接到原子绝缘体，揭示了脆弱拓扑相在平移对称性细化下只有有限稳定性。
AI.motivation: 脆弱拓扑相在加入适当平庸带后会变得平庸，这与稳定拓扑相不同。尽管已提出脆弱相的各种响应现象和材料实现，但许多现象也存在于原子绝缘体中，因此需要厘清哪些性质是脆弱相特有的。扩大晶胞为这一问题提供了自然视角。
AI.method: 建立了基于电子-正子图像和希尔伯特基分析动量空间对称数据的系统框架，用于判断脆弱拓扑在晶胞扩大下的稳定性。对所有二维壁纸群（考虑或不考虑自旋轨道耦合/时间反演对称性）进行了系统性分析。
AI.result: 所有对称性指示的脆弱拓扑相在合适的有限超胞中都绝热连接到原子绝缘体，因此可通过任意小的对称性保持微扰使之平庸化。脆弱拓扑在平移对称性细化下只有有限稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 脆弱拓扑相的命运可能依赖于平移对称性破缺的微扰（如电荷密度波有序），暗示对平移细化不敏感的物理信号不太可能唯一地表征脆弱拓扑。

title: Long Non-Exponential PL Decay from Localized Defect States in Monolayer WSe$_2$ at Low Temperature
summary: We investigate the recombination dynamics of localized defect emission in monolayer WSe$_2$ using time-resolved photoluminescence over the temperature range from 4 to 120 K. The defect emission comprises a dominant sub-nanosecond exponential component and two weak, long-lived power-law channels extending from a few nanoseconds to several hundred nanoseconds. The power-law relaxation admits an interpretation in terms of continuous distributions of recombination lifetimes associated with an inhomogeneous ensemble of localized states. Temperature-dependent measurements were performed to examine the thermal detrapping mechanisms governing these long-lived channels. Spin-resolved electronic-structure and optical-transition calculations provide microscopic insight into the localized states and the available recombination pathways. These results provide a framework for understanding long-lived, non-exponential defect recombination in two-dimensional semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过时间分辨光致发光研究了单层WSe₂中局域缺陷发射的复合动力学，发现主导的亚纳秒指数分量和两个长寿命幂律通道（纳秒到数百纳秒），并通过温度依赖测量和自旋分辨电子结构计算揭示了热脱陷机制及微观复合路径。
AI.motivation: 理解二维半导体中缺陷发光的非指数、长寿命复合动力学的物理机制，特别是局域态的不均匀分布如何导致幂律弛豫行为。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨光致发光技术（4-120 K温度范围），结合自旋分辨的电子结构和光学跃迁计算，分析缺陷发射的复合动力学。
AI.result: 缺陷发射包含一个主导的亚纳秒指数分量和两个弱的长寿命幂律通道（纳秒到数百纳秒）；幂律弛豫可归因于局域态的不均匀系综导致的连续复合寿命分布；温度依赖实验揭示了热脱陷机制；计算提供了局域态和复合路径的微观图像。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解二维半导体中长寿命、非指数缺陷复合行为建立了框架，揭示了局域态不均匀性对弛豫动力学的主导作用。

title: Deterministic cascade coarsening in a Bistable Gene Toggle model
summary: We investigate deterministic coarsening dynamics in a spatially extended bistable gene toggle model with diffusive coupling. Unlike classical curvature-driven coarsening, where domain walls move continuously and annihilate gradually, the present system exhibits a qualitatively different mechanism. The domain walls remain pinned for long intervals and disappear abruptly through collective cascade events. The density of domain walls decays approximately as $ρ(t)\sim t^{-δ}$, but the coarsening exhibits clear log-periodic oscillations superimposed on the power-law behavior. For all values of the promoter strength $α$ considered, the measured exponent satisfies $δ<0.5$, indicating a systematic deviation from the classical Allen--Cahn prediction $δ=1/2$ for curvature-driven coarsening. We show that log-periodic oscillations are not controlled by the density of domain walls, but by the \emph{domains that disappear} in each cascade. The average size of disappearing domains grows roughly linearly with cascade index, producing a constant geometric spacing of cascade times, consistent with discrete scale invariance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种空间扩展双稳态基因切换模型中的确定性粗化动力学，发现不同于经典的曲率驱动粗化，该系统存在畴壁钉扎和集体级联湮灭机制，粗化呈现对数周期振荡且幂律指数δ<0.5，偏离Allen-Cahn预测。
AI.motivation: 探索非经典粗化机制：在双稳态基因切换模型中，畴壁不是连续运动湮灭，而是长时间钉扎后通过集体级联事件突然消失，这偏离了经典的曲率驱动粗化理论，揭示了新的物理机制。
AI.method: 通过数值模拟研究空间扩展双稳态基因切换模型的确定性粗化动力学，分析畴壁密度的时间演化、幂律指数、对数周期振荡特征，以及级联事件中消失畴的尺寸分布。
AI.result: 畴壁密度近似服从ρ(t)~t^{-δ}，但叠加有清晰的对数周期振荡；对所有启动子强度α，测量指数δ<0.5，系统偏离经典Allen-Cahn预测δ=1/2；对数周期振荡受级联中消失畴控制而非畴壁密度；消失畴的平均尺寸随级联索引线性增长，级联时间呈恒定几何间距，符合离散尺度不变性。
AI.conclusion: 该系统的粗化动力学由离散尺度不变性主导的级联事件控制，而非经典的曲率驱动机制，这为理解生物系统中非平衡有序化过程提供了新视角。

title: Optical Properties of Iron-Selenide Na$_{0.27}$K$_{0.27}$Rb$_{0.27}$Fe$_{1.7}$Se$_2$ Single Crystals
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2511.11123
summary: With infrared Fourier-transform spectroscopy and spectroscopic ellipsometry we investigated the in-plane reflectance of the superconducting Na$_{0.27}$K$_{0.27}$Rb$_{0.27}$Fe$_{1.7}$Se$_2$ single crystals with a critical temperature $T_c\approx 34.3$ K over a broad frequency range at temperatures of 4--300 K. The normal-state response of Na$_{0.27}$K$_{0.27}$Rb$_{0.27}$Fe$_{1.7}$Se$_2$ is analyzed by a Drude-Lorentz model with one Drude component. The temperature dependences of the plasma frequency, optical conductivity, scattering rate, and dc resistivity of the Drude component in the normal state are presented. We report a Fano-shaped mode at 1430~cm$^{-1}$ indicating a coupling of the discrete mode presumably related to some electronic transition to a two-magnon continuum as well as a low-frequency broad band assigned to the acoustic magnon branch of the antiferromagnetic superstructure. These features persist in the reflectance in both the normal and superconducting states suggesting a mesoscopic coexistence of superconductivity and magnetism in Na$_{0.27}$K$_{0.27}$Rb$_{0.27}$Fe$_{1.7}$Se$_2$.

AI.tldr: 本文利用红外傅里叶变换光谱和光谱椭偏术，研究了超导Na₀.₂₇K₀.₂₇Rb₀.₂₇Fe₁.₇Se₂单晶在4–300 K温度范围、宽频率范围内的面内反射率。通过Drude-Lorentz模型分析了正常态响应，发现了1430 cm⁻¹处的Fano型模式（离散电子跃迁与双磁子连续谱的耦合）以及低频宽谱带（反铁磁超结构的声学磁子分支），这些特征在正常态和超导态均存在，表明超导与磁性在该材料中呈介观共存。
AI.motivation: 探究Na₀.₂₇K₀.₂₇Rb₀.₂₇Fe₁.₇Se₂单晶中光学响应与电子结构的关系，特别是超导与磁性共存的内在机制。
AI.method: 采用红外傅里叶变换光谱和光谱椭偏术测量面内反射率，利用Drude-Lorentz模型（含一个Drude分量）分析正常态光学响应，提取等离子体频率、光学电导率、散射率和直流电阻率的温度依赖关系。
AI.result: 发现1430 cm⁻¹处存在Fano型模式，归因于离散电子跃迁与双磁子连续谱的耦合；同时观测到低频宽谱带，归因于反铁磁超结构的声学磁子分支。这些特征在正常态和超导态中均持续存在。
AI.conclusion: Na₀.₂₇K₀.₂₇Rb₀.₂₇Fe₁.₇Se₂中超导电性与磁性在介观尺度上共存，两者并非相互排斥。

title: An interaction potential method for passive and active dynamics of hyperelastic materials
summary: Simulating active biological tissues, such as the myocardium, requires constitutive models that are both physically faithful and computationally efficient. The most common approach relies on finite element methods that accurately discretize the underlying continuum hyperelastic problem which, in turn, require global nonlinear solve at each time step. On the other hand, fast, interaction-potential methods replace the continuum with a network of independent links approximating the mechanical response. We propose an interaction potential formulation for simulating active biological tissues that bridges this gap. The method recasts continuum hyperelastic constitutive laws in terms of tetrahedral edge strain. Unlike classical mass-spring models, the proposed formulation does not approximate the tissue as independent spring elements but preserves the energetic coupling between adjacent edges. Passive tissue mechanics is described by hyperelastic constitutive laws, while active contraction is incorporated through the active-strain multiplicative decomposition. Within the edge-based formulation, the active strain is incorporated through a time-dependent activated reference configuration. We further introduce a strategy for enforcing the material incompressibility constraint while avoiding volumetric locking. The resulting method can be interpreted as an edge-strain representation of a constant-strain tetrahedral continuum element, providing a bridge between continuum mechanics and discrete interaction potential solvers. Numerical tests demonstrate the capability of the method to effectively simulate different hyperelastic constitutive laws and to properly preserve the energy balance equation. Finally, the proposed method is applied to the active deformation of a realistic ventricle, reproducing longitudinal shortening and wall-thickening values consistent with the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于边缘应变（edge-strain）的相互作用势公式，用于模拟活性生物组织（如心肌）。该方法将连续介质超弹性本构律重新表达为四面体边缘应变形式，保留了相邻边缘间的能量耦合，并通过活性应变乘法分解引入主动收缩。该方法介于连续介质力学与离散相互作用势求解器之间，兼具物理保真度与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 传统有限元方法虽精度高但需全局非线性求解，计算成本高；而快速相互作用势方法（如质量-弹簧模型）将组织近似为独立链接，损失了物理真实性。本文旨在弥合这一差距，提出一种既保持连续介质力学准确性、又具备离散方法高效性的新公式。
AI.method: 1) 将超弹性本构律重新表述为四面体边缘应变形式；2) 通过活性应变乘法分解（active-strain multiplicative decomposition）引入主动收缩，以时间依赖的激活参考构型实现；3) 提出一种避免体积锁定的不可压缩性约束策略；4) 该方法可解释为常应变四面体连续单元的边缘应变表示。
AI.result: 数值测试表明该方法能有效模拟不同超弹性本构律，正确保持能量平衡方程。在真实心室活性变形模拟中，成功再现了纵向缩短和室壁增厚等生理指标，与文献结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该边缘应变相互作用势公式成功搭建了连续介质力学与离散求解器之间的桥梁，为活性生物组织模拟提供了一种兼具物理准确性和计算效率的新途径。

title: Coherent Magnons Driven by Photomodulated Anisotropy in Altermagnetic MnTe
summary: Manganese telluride ($\text{MnTe}$) has recently emerged as a prototypical $g$-wave altermagnet, providing an ideal platform to investigate the non-equilibrium excitations of altermagnetic order. Here, we report simultaneous spatial mapping of the local equilibrium orientation of the Néel vector, $\varphi_L(\mathbf{r})$, alongside the amplitude, $Δ\varphi(\mathbf{r},t)$, and frequency, $Ω(\mathbf{r})$, of photoexcited spin waves. Based on these measurements, we place a remarkably low upper bound of $\approx 60~μ\text{eV}$ (0.7 K) on the spin-wave gap arising from intrinsic anisotropy. This exceptionally weak hexagonal anisotropy ($K_6$) renders the altermagnetic order highly susceptible to optical tuning, allowing coherent spin waves to be driven by a photoinduced enhancement of $K_6$. Above a threshold pump fluence, our spatial maps reveal that this photomodulation manifests as a six-fold symmetric sawtooth dependence of $Δ\varphi$ on $\varphi_L$ and a cycloid-like modulation of $Ω$. Ultimately, the near-isotropy of the Néel vector in $\text{MnTe}$ enables optical and mechanical control over the orientation of spin-splitting in the electronic band structure, offering new pathways for altermagnetic spintronics.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过空间映射技术，在MnTe中测量了Néel矢量平衡取向、光激发自旋波振幅和频率，发现其六方各向异性极弱（<0.7 K），导致自旋波间隙极小（≈60 μeV）。这种近各向同性使Néel矢量易受光学调控，进而实现对电子能带结构中自旋分裂方向的光学和力学控制。
AI.motivation: MnTe作为典型的g波交变磁体，是研究交变磁序非平衡激发的理想平台，但对其自旋波间隙和各向异性的定量表征尚不充分，限制了对其光学调控能力的理解。
AI.method: 同时进行空间映射：测量Néel矢量局域平衡取向φ_L(r)、光激发自旋波的振幅Δφ(r,t)和频率Ω(r)，结合泵浦-探测技术研究光致各向异性增强效应。
AI.result: 自旋波间隙上限≈60 μeV（0.7 K），六方各向异性K_6极弱；超过阈值泵浦通量后，Δφ对φ_L呈现六重对称锯齿依赖，Ω呈现摆线调制。
AI.conclusion: MnTe中Néel矢量的近各向同性了实现光学和力学调控电子能带结构自旋分裂方向，为交变磁体自旋电子学开辟新路径。

title: Quantum-Enabled Spintronic "Small" Antennas
summary: Antennas transmit information wirelessly from one location to another via electromagnetic waves. Miniaturizing them, however, is challenging since the radiation efficiencies of all traditional antennas, based on the principles of classical electromagnetics, plummet when their dimensions are shrunk to tiny fractions of the radiated wavelength. Lately, a new generation of antennas whose operations are underpinned by non-classical principles have been demonstrated and they can overcome this limitation. This enables embedded applications that were hitherto inaccessible. In addition, beam steering, which normally requires a large phased array (multiple antenna elements each much larger than the wavelength), can now be accomplished with a single element much smaller than the wavelength. Some of these antennas also have stealth attributes for secure and covert communication, which makes this new genre a disruptive new technology.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于非经典电磁学原理的新型天线，能够在尺寸远小于波长的情况下保持高效率辐射，并实现单元件波束转向和隐身通信功能，是一种颠覆性技术。
AI.motivation: 传统天线遵循经典电磁学原理，当尺寸缩小到辐射波长的极小分数时，辐射效率急剧下降，这限制了天线在嵌入式等微型化应用场景中的使用。因此，需要一种能够突破这一尺寸-效率瓶颈的新型天线技术。
AI.method: 采用非经典电磁学原理（如量子效应、超材料、拓扑光子学等另类物理机制）来设计天线，替代传统的基于经典电磁学的辐射机制，从而在极小尺寸下保持高辐射效率。
AI.result: 新型天线在尺寸远小于波长的情况下仍能保持高效辐射；单个元件即可实现传统上需要大型相控阵才能完成的波束转向；部分天线具备隐身特性，适用于安全隐蔽通信。
AI.conclusion: 基于非经典原理的新型天线克服了传统天线的微型化瓶颈，开启了此前无法实现的嵌入式应用，并具备波束转向和隐身等颠覆性能力，有望成为新一代无线通信的关键技术。

title: Vacancy Diffusion Across FeCrAl Alloy Composition Space for Accident-Tolerant Fuel Cladding
summary: Iron-chromium-aluminium (FeCrAl) alloys are leading candidates for accident-tolerant fuel cladding in light-water reactors, where their superior high-temperature oxidation resistance promises to extend coping times during loss-of-coolant accidents. The in-reactor lifetime of cladding is ultimately governed by radiation-induced microstructural evolution of which point defect transport is the dominant mechanism, however, this remains poorly understood. Here, we use a species-resolved kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) model for vacancy diffusion in FeCrAl, parameterised by linear surrogate models trained on a database of migration barriers generated through the Hop-Decorate workflow. By sampling compositions spanning the Fe-rich to Cr-rich range of the Fe-Cr-Al system, we map how the local chemical environment controls vacancy hopping and hence macroscopic diffusivity. We find that increasing the Cr content in the alloy progressively decreases global diffusivity of vacancies even though activation energies stay relatively constant. This implies that the higher the Fe content in the alloy, the faster vacancies diffuse, thereby increasing annihilation events with fast-moving interstitials, potentially reducing irradiation induced defects and increasing radiation tolerance. Conversely, we find that Cr-rich alloy compositions stand out with a markedly elevated activation energy and significantly slower diffusion, orders of magnitude lower at accident-relevant temperatures. This indicates suppressed vacancy mobility in Cr-rich $α'$ phases which are known to form under irradiation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过物种分辨动力学蒙特卡罗模型研究FeCrAl合金中空位扩散机制，发现Cr含量增加会降低空位扩散率，而富Fe合金具有更好的抗辐射性能，富Crα'相中的空位迁移率显著降低。
AI.motivation: FeCrAl合金是轻水堆事故容错燃料包壳的主要候选材料，其高温抗氧化性能优越，但辐照下点缺陷输运机制（主导微观结构演化）尚不清楚，亟需理解以评估包壳在堆内寿命。
AI.method: 采用物种分辨动力学蒙特卡罗（KMC）模型模拟FeCrAl中空位扩散，通过Hop-Decorate工作流生成迁移势垒数据库并训练线性代理模型进行参数化，采样Fe-Cr-Al体系中富Fe至富Cr范围的成分。
AI.result: 增加Cr含量会逐步降低空位的全局扩散率，尽管活化能保持相对恒定；富Fe合金中空位扩散更快，促进与快迁移间隙子的湮灭，可能减少辐照缺陷；富Cr合金（如α'相）活化能显著升高，在事故相关温度下扩散率降低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Fe含量越高，空位扩散越快，有利于提高抗辐射性能；而辐照下形成的富Crα'相中空位迁移率受抑制，可能影响合金的辐照行为。

title: Energy Conversion, Fluctuation Suppression, and Information Transfer in the Thermodynamic Performance of Kinesin
summary: Kinesin is a molecular motor that transports intracellular cargoes along microtubules. Recent studies have quantified kinesin performance using various efficiencies within the framework of stochastic thermodynamics; however, quantitative comparisons remain difficult because different models and assumptions have been employed. As a result, it remains unclear which aspect of kinesin performance, if any, is thermodynamically optimized. Here, we systematically compare multiple thermodynamic efficiencies within a single kinesin-cargo model. To this end, we construct a thermodynamically consistent two-state kinesin-cargo model that retains both the discrete stepping of kinesin and its coupling to the cargo. Assuming a separation of time scales between the motor and the cargo, we derive analytical expressions for the thermodynamic efficiency, the information-thermodynamic efficiency, the thermodynamic uncertainty relation (TUR) efficiency, and the bipartite TUR efficiency, and compare them with numerical simulation results. We find that these efficiencies generally remain low, suggesting that kinesin is not optimized for maximizing the thermodynamic efficiencies considered here. Our results suggest that thermodynamic efficiencies alone may not fully characterize kinesin performance and motivate further investigation of complementary kinetic perspectives for assessing molecular motor function.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个热力学一致的kinesin-货物两态模型，系统比较了多种热力学效率，发现kinesin并未针对最大化这些效率进行优化，提示单纯热力学效率不足以全面表征分子马达性能。
AI.motivation: 已有研究使用随机热力学框架量化kinesin的性能，但由于不同模型和假设导致定量比较困难，不清楚kinesin在热力学上是否被优化以及哪方面被优化。
AI.method: 构建热力学一致的两态kinesin-货物模型，保留kinesin的离散步进及其与货物的耦合；利用马达与货物时间尺度分离假设，推导热力学效率、信息-热力学效率、TUR效率和二分TUR效率的解析表达式，并与数值模拟结果对比。
AI.result: 多种热力学效率普遍较低，表明kinesin并未针对最大化这些热力学效率进行优化。
AI.conclusion: 单纯热力学效率可能不足以全面表征kinesin性能，需要进一步从互补的动力学视角评估分子马达功能。

title: Annealing-enhanced spin-orbit effects in non-centrosymmetric superconducting NbRe films
summary: $\text{Nb}_{0.18}\text{Re}_{0.82}$ (NbRe) is a non-centrosymmetric superconductor with a transition temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$ reaching $9\text{ K}$ in bulk form. While bulk and single-crystalline NbRe exhibit signatures of multigap superconductivity, thin films generally display a single-gap superconducting state due to structural disorder and reduced crystallite dimensions. Here, we investigate the impact of thermal annealing on the superconducting and normal-state magnetotransport properties of NbRe films. The temperature dependence of the upper critical field, $B_{\mathrm{c2}}(T)$, is analyzed within the microscopic Werthamer--Helfand--Hohenberg (WHH) framework, while the normal-state magnetoconductivity is described using the three-dimensional Kawabata weak-localization/weak-anti-localization model. Annealing drives a pronounced change in the electronic response, manifested by a strong weak anti-localization behavior in the normal state and an upper critical field that surpasses both the conventional orbital-limiting field and the Pauli paramagnetic limit. The microscopic analysis reveals a strong intrinsic increase in the relative spin--orbit scattering strength, with the annealed film showing a significantly enhanced spin--orbit-to-dephasing field ratio. These findings provide direct, independent evidence that thermal modification of the NbRe microstructure successfully amplifies spin--orbit-mediated quantum transport, which acts as the key mechanism protecting the non-centrosymmetric superconducting state against paramagnetic pair-breaking well beyond conventional theoretical boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究热处理对非中心对称超导体Nb₀.₁₈Re₀.₈₂薄膜的超导及正常态磁输运性质的影响。退火处理显著增强了自旋-轨道散射强度，使上临界场超越传统轨道极限和Pauli顺磁极限，表明热退火可通过增强自旋-轨道耦合来保护非中心对称超导态。
AI.motivation: 块材和单晶NbRe显示多能隙超导特征，但薄膜因结构无序和晶粒尺寸减小而呈现单能隙超导态。作者希望探究热退火是否能调控NbRe薄膜的微观结构，从而增强自旋-轨道耦合，保护非中心对称超导态。
AI.method: 采用Werthamer-Helfand-Hohenberg (WHH) 微观理论分析上临界场的温度依赖关系；利用三维Kawabata弱局域化/弱反局域化模型描述正常态磁导率。
AI.result: 退火使薄膜正常态呈现强弱反局域化行为；上临界场超越传统轨道极限和Pauli顺磁极限；自旋-轨道散射与退相干场之比显著增大。
AI.conclusion: 热退火通过增强自旋-轨道耦合介导的量子输运，使非中心对称超导态能够抵御顺磁对破缺，突破传统理论边界。

title: ATLAS: A Foundation Neural Sampler for Amorphous Materials
summary: Amorphous materials exhibit exceptional mechanical and functional properties, yet their rugged energy landscapes are notoriously difficult to sample. Below the glass-transition temperature, conventional molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo become inefficient because equilibration relies on rare barrier-crossing events, while data-driven generative models are constrained by scarce and biased reference ensembles. Here, we introduce ATLAS, an efficient sampler that learns a diffusion process to generate Boltzmann-distributed amorphous structures directly from a target energy function. Parameterized by an equivariant graph neural network, ATLAS generalizes across system size, temperature, and composition. By exploiting the time reversal of the diffusion process, it enables efficient estimation of thermodynamic quantities and steering toward target observables. In two-dimensional Kob-Andersen systems, ATLAS reproduces parallel tempering Markov chain Monte Carlo structural distributions, free energies and entropies, achieving below 0.2% free energy error in the low-temperature glass regime with over 500-fold fewer energy evaluations. In Cu-Zr and Cr-Co-Ni metallic glasses, ATLAS recovers experimentally observed short-range-order trends and steers structures toward prescribed order parameters and optimized bulk moduli. Moreover, composition-amortized pretraining outperforms composition-specific training from scratch, reduces inverse-design costs by several hundred-fold, and enables sampling with expensive universal machine learning interatomic potentials. Coupled to a large language model agent, ATLAS searches an eight-element space for high-entropy metallic glasses balancing stiffness and ductility, identifying a converged Pareto frontier within 480 oracle evaluations. Together, these results establish ATLAS as a foundation model for sampling, steering and designing amorphous materials.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个基于扩散过程的生成式采样器，利用等变图神经网络直接从目标能量函数生成玻尔兹曼分布的非晶结构，在效率上比传统方法提升500倍以上，并能推广到不同体系、温度和组成，实现了非晶材料的采样、操控与逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 非晶材料具有优异的力学和功能特性，但其崎岖的能量景观极难采样。在玻璃化转变温度以下，传统分子动力学和蒙特卡洛方法因依赖稀有的势垒穿越事件而效率低下，而数据驱动的生成模型又受限于稀缺和有偏的参考系综。
AI.method: ATLAS学习一个扩散过程，直接从目标能量函数生成玻尔兹曼分布的非晶结构。方法核心包括：(1) 用等变图神经网络参数化扩散模型；(2) 利用扩散过程的时间反转高效估计热力学量并导向目标可观测量；(3) 支持系统尺寸、温度和组成的泛化；(4) 结合大语言模型智能体实现多元素空间的高效搜索。
AI.result: 在二维Kob-Andersen体系中，ATLAS复现了并行回火MCMC的结构分布、自由能和熵，在低温玻璃态下自由能误差低于0.2%，能量评估次数减少500倍以上。在Cu-Zr和Cr-Co-Ni金属玻璃中，恢复了实验观察的短程序趋势，并能导向指定序参量和优化体积模量。组成摊销预训练比从零训练效率高数百倍。结合LLM智能体，在8元素空间中480次评估内收敛到帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS可作为非晶材料采样、操控和设计的基座模型，极大提升了效率并降低了计算成本。

title: Theory of two-dimensional Wigner crystals with defects: Interactions, melting transitions and collective modes
summary: The physics of Wigner solids is characterized by an interplay of elasticity and long-range electrostatics, endowing crystal defects with properties distinct from those in charge-neutral crystals. Recent experiments observing lattice melting and Wigner-crystal-adjacent phases in two dimensions necessitate an examination of how defects affect the long-wavelength properties of such solids. Here, we use duality techniques to construct a comprehensive framework for studying the contribution of vacancies and interstitials, dislocations, and disclinations to the effective action of two-dimensional charged crystals. This allows for a systematic investigation of the interaction energies for the different combinations of defect pairs. We further study melting transitions due to defect proliferation, assessing and justifying some of the assumptions present in the literature. In the metallic Wigner crystal phase, characterized by a finite ground state density of vacancies, we find phonons with a dispersion relation that varies in an unusual way with the vacancy density. Consequently, we discuss how thermodynamic properties of such a vacancy Fermi liquid can be probed in measurements of the melting temperature and speed of sound. The field theory developed here can serve as a starting point in the study of anomalous Hall crystals and charge density waves with defects.

AI.tldr: 本文利用对偶技术构建了一个统一框架，系统研究二维Wigner晶体中空位、间隙原子、位错和向错等缺陷对长波长性质的影响，并分析了缺陷增殖导致的熔化转变，以及在金属性Wigner晶体相中空位费米液体的非常规声子色散关系。
AI.motivation: 近期实验观测到二维Wigner晶体的晶格熔化及邻近相，而此类带电晶体中缺陷的弹性与长程静电相互作用交织，其性质与电中性晶体截然不同，因此亟需一个系统的理论框架来研究缺陷如何影响带电晶体的长波长有效性质。
AI.method: 采用对偶技术（duality techniques）构建有效作用量框架，系统纳入空位/间隙原子、位错和向错三种缺陷类型，分析不同缺陷对的相互作用能，并研究缺陷增殖驱动的熔化转变。
AI.result: 在金属性Wigner晶体相（基态具有有限空位密度）中，发现声子色散关系以非常规方式依赖于空位密度；讨论了该空位费米液体的热力学性质如何通过熔化温度和声速测量来探测。
AI.conclusion: 所构建的场论框架为研究反常霍尔晶体和含缺陷的电荷密度波系统提供了出发点，并为理解二维带电晶体中缺陷物理及熔化行为建立了系统基础。

title: Charge transfer mediated anomalous photoluminescence enhancement in monolayer MoS2 graphene heterostructure via polystyrene assisted wet transfer
summary: Van der Waals MoS2 graphene heterostructures are compelling candidates for high performance electronic and optoelectronic device applications. However, the interlayer charge transfer typically quenches the photoluminescence of monolayer MoS2, limiting the use of these heterostructures in light emitting applications. In this work, we report an anomalous photoluminescence enhancement in n-type monolayer MoS2 by integrating it with monolayer graphene via polystyrene assisted wet transfer process. Photoluminescence spectroscopy reveals a dominant trion to exciton conversion in the heterostructure. Kelvin probe force microscopy shows a 600 meV increase in the work function of MoS2 upon heterostructure formation. This work function shift, together with the higher work function of graphene, signifies electron transfer from MoS2 to graphene. Shifts in the graphene G and 2D Raman modes further corroborate the interlayer charge transfer. Hydroxyl and epoxy functionalization of graphene following heterostructure formation is evidenced by X ray photoelectron spectroscopy. DFT based Bader charge analysis quantifies the role of these functional groups in facilitating interlayer charge transfer. Collectively, our findings establish polystyrene assisted wet transfer as a practical interface engineering strategy for enhancing excitonic emission in MoS2 graphene heterostructures, thereby advancing their potential for scalable optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了通过聚苯乙烯辅助湿法转移技术，在n型单层MoS₂与单层石墨烯异质结中实现了反常的光致发光增强，主要机制为三子向激子的转化以及界面电荷转移的调控。
AI.motivation: MoS₂/石墨烯异质结因层间电荷转移通常会导致MoS₂光致发光猝灭，限制了其在发光器件中的应用。本文旨在通过界面工程策略逆转这一现象，实现发光增强。
AI.method: 采用聚苯乙烯辅助湿法转移技术制备MoS₂/石墨烯异质结；利用光致发光光谱、开尔文探针力显微镜、拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱及DFT-Bader电荷分析进行表征。
AI.result: 实现了光致发光增强，主因是三子向激子的转化；MoS₂功函数增加600 meV；石墨烯出现羟基和环氧基功能化；DFT证实官能团促进了层间电荷转移。
AI.conclusion: 聚苯乙烯辅助湿法转移是一种实用的界面工程策略，可增强MoS₂/石墨烯异质结的激子发射，推动其在可扩展光电器件中的应用。

title: Data-Efficient Training of Linear ACE Potentials through Leverage-Guided Subset Selection of ASSYST Structure Pools
summary:
The construction of machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) is often limited by the cost of generating large density-functional-theory (DFT) training datasets. For systematically generated structure pools such as ASSYST, a central practical question is how many configurations must be labeled to achieve reliable accuracy. Here we assess geometry-based, label-free subset selection for training linear Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) potentials. Using statistical leverage scores and CUR-type sampling, we compare leverage-guided selection against random, energy-based, and force-based baselines under controlled iterative protocols. Elemental Al provides the primary benchmark, with Cu and Al-Cu alloys used for transfer validation. Leverage-guided subsets recover plateau-level energy and force accuracy using substantially smaller labeled fractions (approximately 30-40%) than random sampling, corresponding to an effective 2-3x reduction in DFT labeling for the systems studied. In alloy tests, defect energetics remain comparable across strategies once sufficient chemical diversity is included, while leverage selection maintains competitive accuracy at reduced training size.
  These results demonstrate that descriptor-space-guided, label-free subsampling can significantly reduce DFT workload for linear ACE models trained on ASSYST structure pools without degrading defect-level fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于几何结构（无需标签）的子集选择方法，用于训练线性原子团簇展开（ACE）势能模型。通过统计杠杆分数和CUR采样，在Al、Cu及Al-Cu合金体系中，仅需30-40%的DFT标记数据即可达到与全数据集相当的精度，实现2-3倍的标签成本降低。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势能（MLIP）的训练受限于生成大规模DFT数据集的高昂成本，亟需一种无需标签即可高效筛选代表性结构子集的方法，以减少DFT计算量。
AI.method: 采用统计杠杆分数（leverage scores）和CUR型采样进行无标签子集选择，并与随机采样、基于能量和力的基线方法进行对比，在迭代协议下评估线性ACE模型的训练效果。
AI.result: 杠杆引导的子集仅用30-40%的标记数据即可达到与全数据集相近的能量和力精度，相当于DFT标记量减少2-3倍；在合金体系中，缺陷能量精度在化学多样性充足时与其他策略相当。
AI.conclusion: 描述符空间引导的无标签子采样可显著降低线性ACE模型在ASSYST结构池上的DFT计算负担，且不损失缺陷级别的预测保真度。

title: Discrete distributions and statistical mechanics of small systems
summary:
We study connections between discrete probability distributions and the statistical mechanics of small systems. Using probability generating functions, we develop the theory of power series, infinitely divisible, and scalable distributions of non-negative integer-valued random variables, and introduce the class of Markovian distributions that arise naturally in stationary solutions of birth-death processes and in scalable infinitely divisible distributions.
  These results are applied to the grand canonical ensemble description in statistical mechanics: the infinite divisibility leads to a quasiparticle picture of an interacting gas, and the virial expansion is linked to the combinants of the distribution. A kinetic model of the liquid-vapor phase transition is presented, in which the particle-number distribution at the critical point converges to the Discrete Stable distribution - the fixed point of a renormalization semi-group transformation. We also show that the scalability of the particle-number distribution is preserved in Tsallis non-extensive thermodynamics, even though infinite divisibility fails. Moreover, deformed discrete distributions, including the negative binomial as a q-deformation of the Poisson, arise naturally in this setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了离散概率分布与统计力学小系统之间的联系，利用概率生成函数发展了幂级数分布、无限可分布和可缩放分布理论，并应用于巨正则系综、维里展开、液气相变动力学模型及Tsallis非广延热力学。
AI.motivation: 建立离散概率分布理论与统计力学小系统之间的形式化联系，探索无限可分性、可缩放性等概率性质在统计物理中的物理意义和应用价值。
AI.method: 利用概率生成函数作为理论工具，发展幂级数分布、无限可分布和可缩放分布理论；引入马尔可夫分布类，通过生灭过程的稳态解和可缩放无限可分布自然导出这些分布；应用巨正则系综描述，将无限可分性与相互作用气体的准粒子图像联系起来，将维里展开与分布的组合量（combinants）建立联系。
AI.result: 建立了液气相变的动力学模型，发现临界点处的粒子数分布收敛到离散稳定分布（重整化半群变换的不动点）；证明了在Tsallis非广延热力学中可缩放性仍然保持，但无限可分性失效；揭示了负二项分布作为泊松分布的q-变形自然出现。
AI.conclusion: 离散概率分布的无限可分性和可缩放性为统计力学提供了新的数学工具和物理洞察，特别是在临界现象和非广延热力学中具有重要应用价值。

title: A unified tight-binding description of the electronic structure and Ising protection of superconductivity in misfit layered compounds
summary: Misfit layered compounds (MLCs) offer a unique bulk platform for realizing exotic quantum states typically associated with two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), most notably Ising-protected superconductivity. Yet a theoretical description capturing their electronic structure beyond the simplistic picture of electronically isolated TMD layers has been lacking. Here, we develop a unified tight-binding model for metal dichalcogenide-based MLCs, parameterized by extensive density-functional theory (DFT) calculations across multiple structural configurations and chemical compositions. We show that the intervening tetragonal layers play an active role beyond charge reservoirs: they mediate a significant interlayer spin-orbit coupling entirely absent in the standard rigid-band picture. This emergent interlayer spin-orbit coupling is essential for reproducing the DFT band structure of bulk MLCs and, when incorporated into Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations, provides a microscopic mechanism for the Ising protection of superconductivity by strongly enhancing the in-plane critical field. Our framework establishes MLCs as a distinct class of three-dimensional materials with intrinsically coupled layers and emergent spin-orbit phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 misfit layered compounds (MLCs) 发展了一个统一的紧束缚模型，发现中间四方层在电荷库之外还起到活性作用，介导了传统刚性带模型中完全缺失的显著层间自旋轨道耦合。该耦合对于再现块体MLCs的能带结构至关重要，并解释了Ising保护超导性的微观机制，从而将MLCs确立为一类具有本征层间耦合和新兴自旋轨道现象的三维材料。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，MLCs中过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）层被认为是电子隔离的，缺乏一个能够准确描述其电子结构的理论描述。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立一个超越传统刚性带图像的统一理论模型。
AI.method: 通过大量密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，覆盖多种结构构型和化学组成，开发了一个针对基于金属二硫属化物的MLCs的统一紧束缚模型。进一步结合Bogoliubov–de Gennes计算分析超导性质。
AI.result: 发现中间四方层不是简单的电荷库，而是介导了显著的层间自旋轨道耦合；该耦合对重现DFT能带结构必不可少，并在超导中极大增强了面内临界场，提供了Ising保护超导性的微观机制。
AI.conclusion: MLCs应被理解为一种独特的三维材料类别，其层间耦合和新兴自旋轨道现象是本征的，这为理解相关量子态（如Ising超导）提供了新的理论框架。

title: Manifest charge-transfer physics in T$^\prime$-La$_2$NiO$_4$
summary: The La$_2$NiO$_4$ compound stabilizes in nature in the so-called T structure with octahedral oxygen coordination of the Ni site. Motivated by a similarly existing polymorph for La$_2$CuO$_4$ in the cuprate system, we here study La$_2$NiO$_4$ in the T$^\prime$-structure with square-planar oxygen coordination of Ni by means of first-principles many-body theory. The hypothetical T$^\prime$-La$_2$NiO$_4$ compound turns out to be a manifest charge-transfer insulator with a cuprate-like charge gap of $\sim 1.8$ eV. Upon doping, a strong carrier asymmetry is revealed, i.e. while holes dominantly enter O$(2p)$-derived states, electrons may become itinerant majorly within effective Ni-$d_{x^2-y^2}$ states. Nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic ordering at stoichiometry appears absent in the T$^\prime$ structure, in stark contrast to the strong antiferromagnetism in the T structure. Our theoretical study opens up new pathways for correlation physics in layered nickelates with challenging charge-transfer signatures, awaiting experimental inquiries.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过第一性原理多体理论计算，预测了T'-La₂NiO₄（具有方形平面氧配位）是一种类铜酸盐的电荷转移绝缘体，带隙约1.8 eV，表现出强载流子不对称性（空穴进入O-2p态，电子进入Ni-d态）且反铁磁序被抑制，为层状镍酸盐的关联物理开辟了新方向。
AI.motivation: 受铜酸盐体系中T'结构La₂CuO₄存在的启发，探究La₂NiO₄在T'结构（Ni处于方形平面氧配位）下的电子性质，以揭示其是否具有类似铜酸盐的电荷转移绝缘体特征和关联物理。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理多体理论（first-principles many-body theory）对假想的T'-La₂NiO₄化合物进行电子结构和关联效应的理论计算研究。
AI.result: (1) T'-La₂NiO₄是典型的电荷转移绝缘体，电荷带隙约1.8 eV，与铜酸盐类似；(2) 掺杂后呈现强载流子不对称性：空穴主要进入O-2p衍生态，电子主要在Ni-d_{x²-y²}态中巡游；(3) 化学计量比下最近邻反铁磁序被抑制，与T结构的强反铁磁性形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 理论预测表明T'-La₂NiO₄具有类铜酸盐的电荷转移特征和独特的载流子行为，为层状镍酸盐的关联物理研究开辟了新方向，期待实验验证。

title: Conductivity of the Landau levels of two-dimensional Dirac cones and gapped nodal-rings in the quantum limit under impurity-potentials
summary: We investigate the dc magnetoconductivity of two-dimensional Dirac cones and gapped nodal rings (GNRs) subjected to a perpendicular magnetic field, which quantises the electronic spectrum into Landau levels (LLs). Working in the ultraquantum limit, where only the lowest LL (LLL) is partially occupied, we employ the Kubo--Bastin formalism to compute the transport coefficients for pointlike, Gaussian, and Yukawa impurity-potentials. For the Dirac case, the longitudinal conductivity is field-independent for pointlike impurities and a monotonic function of $B$ for the Gaussian and Yukawa potentials, while the Hall conductivity vanishes identically owing to the particle-hole symmetry of the two neighbouring LLs. The GNR case is qualitatively different: its non-monotonic stretched-checkmark LL spectrum causes the effective LLL to migrate to successively lower indices as the field increases, producing a pronounced oscillatory structure in both conductivities. The longitudinal response develops resonant peaks at LLL degeneracies, while the Hall conductivity traces out a sawtooth pattern with sharp zero-crossings at these same points. These results establish distinct transport fingerprints for the two systems in the extreme quantum limit, and provide a theoretical framework for interpreting magnetotransport experiments on GNRs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维狄拉克锥和带隙节点环（GNRs）在垂直磁场下的直流磁电导率。在超量子极限下，使用Kubo-Bastin形式计算了点状、高斯和Yukawa杂质势的输运系数。狄拉克情况：点状杂质时纵向电导率与场无关，高斯和Yukawa势时是B的单调函数，霍尔电导率为零。GNR情况：非单调的LL谱导致有效LLL随场增强向更低指数迁移，产生显著的振荡结构，纵向电导出现共振峰，霍尔电导呈锯齿状。这些结果确立了两种系统在极端量子极限下的不同输运特征，为解释GNR磁输运实验提供了理论框架。
AI.motivation: 区分狄拉克锥和带隙节点环（GNRs）在极端量子极限下的磁输运行为，建立各自独特的输运指纹，为解释相关实验提供理论基础。
AI.method: 在超量子极限下，使用Kubo-Bastin形式计算输运系数，考虑点状、高斯和Yukawa三种杂质势，研究二维狄拉克锥和GNRs的直流磁电导率。
AI.result: 狄拉克锥：点状杂质下纵向电导率与磁场无关，高斯和Yukawa势下为B的单调函数；霍尔电导率由于粒子-空穴对称性恒为零。GNRs：非单调的LL谱导致有效LLL向低指数迁移，纵向电导出现共振峰，霍尔电导呈现锯齿状并在LL简并点处零交叉。
AI.conclusion: 两种系统在极端量子极限下具有截然不同的输运指纹，该理论框架可用于解释GNR的磁输运实验。

title: Battery Material Comparisons Should Refocus on Diffusivity with Best Practices
summary: The continuous demand for improved batteries motivates the discovery and advancement of materials with improved transport. Ionic diffusivity is the relevant material property where its measurement depends on accurate assessment of the active material length-scale, generally from the mass-specific surface area. In this perspective, we argue for renewed focus on diffusivity comparisons. A procedural review of 303 recent open-access publications about battery material development revealed two aspects: (1) 49% of publications support structure-property transport claims using diffusivity values and (2) of those reporting diffusivity values, 15% clearly stated that the length scale was measured after grinding-alone or stated that grinding was not used at all. Diffusivity assessment rationally requires length scale measurement after grinding (grind-measure), rather than the reverse. A range of measurement methods are compared, including SEM, BET, and SAXS as well as the resulting apparent diffusivities. Common errors and pitfalls of each of these approaches are described. As an example, datasets are presented for TiNb2O7 (TNO1) and Ti2Nb10O29 (TNO2) made from sol-gel (SOL) and solid state (SS) techniques using rigorous quantitative measurements to separately compare material diffusivities and galvanostatic performance. Here, the SOL samples had shorter length-scales and lower diffusion coefficients. Galvanostatic cell measurements, however, revealed that the shorter length-scales more than compensated for the lower diffusivities with better overall high-rate capacity retention. This example shows how cell level metrics often differ from underlying diffusivities. We argue that materials development needs renewed focus on property measurements like diffusivity where best-practices are important to derive meaningful insights towards structure-property relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在电池材料研究中，离子扩散率的准确测量常因活性材料长度尺度测量不当而被误导。通过对303篇开放获取论文的回顾发现，仅15%的研究正确执行了“研磨后测量”流程。作者以TiNb2O7和Ti2Nb10O29为例，展示了长度尺度与扩散系数的权衡关系，呼吁重新聚焦扩散率这一基础物性的准确测量。
AI.motivation: 电池性能提升依赖于材料传输特性（离子扩散率）的准确表征，但当前文献中广泛存在因长度尺度测量顺序错误（先测量后研磨）导致的扩散率误报，阻碍了可靠的结构-性能关系建立。
AI.method: 对303篇开放获取电池材料论文进行系统性程序审查，统计扩散率报告率及长度尺度测量方法（SEM、BET、SAXS）的正确性。同时以溶胶-凝胶法和固相法合成的TiNb2O7和Ti2Nb10O29为例，进行定量比较实验。
AI.result: 49%的论文使用扩散率支持结构-性能传输论断，但仅15%明确说明长度尺度在研磨后测量（或未研磨）。案例中，溶胶-凝胶样品具有更小长度尺度和更低扩散系数，但在电池级测试中因较短扩散路径补偿了低扩散率，展现出更好的高倍率容量保持率。
AI.conclusion: 电池材料开发需要重新聚焦于扩散率等基础物性的准确测量，遵循“研磨后测量”的最佳实践，才能从材料级性能与电池级性能的差异中获得有意义的构效关系洞见。

title: Boundary quenches in (1+1)-dimensional conformal field theory
summary: We investigate a class of local quantum quenches in which the conformal boundary condition of a (1+1)-dimensional conformal field theory is abruptly changed. We derive a remarkably simple and universal expression for the time evolution of one-point functions on the half-line. This result provides a direct description of the propagation of the disturbance generated by the quench and, in turn, allows us to determine the dynamics of bipartite entanglement for subsystems adjacent to the boundary. We show that, once the subsystem becomes fully causally connected to the quench event, the entanglement entropy undergoes a sharp finite jump whose magnitude is universally given by the logarithm of the ratio of the boundary g-factors associated with the initial and final boundary conditions. We benchmark these analytical predictions against Matrix Product State simulations of the critical Ising spin chain, finding excellent agreement. The numerical analysis further allows us to investigate the time evolution of the spin-flip entanglement asymmetry, revealing how the symmetry-breaking perturbation emitted from the boundary propagates through the system. Our results uncover universal dynamical signatures of boundary quenches and establish a direct connection between nonequilibrium entanglement dynamics and boundary critical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文研究(1+1)维共形场论中边界条件突然改变引发的局域量子淬火，推导出一类单点函数时间演化的普适表达式，发现纠缠熵在子系统完全因果连接到淬火事件时会发生一个有限跳跃，跳跃幅度由初始和最终边界条件的g因子比值的对数给出。通过临界Ising链的矩阵乘积态模拟验证了理论预测，并研究了自旋翻转纠缠不对称性的时间演化。
AI.motivation: 探究边界量子淬火（边界条件突然改变）在(1+1)维共形场论中引发的非平衡动力学，特别是理解这种淬火如何影响单点函数、纠缠熵等物理量的时间演化，以及这些动力学行为与边界临界现象之间的深层联系。
AI.method: 理论推导：利用共形场论框架，推导边界条件突变后单点函数时间演化的普适表达式。数值验证：对临界Ising自旋链进行矩阵乘积态(MPS)模拟，将理论预测与数值结果对比，并进一步研究自旋翻转纠缠不对称性。
AI.result: 1) 得到单点函数时间演化的简洁普适表达式；2) 发现纠缠熵在子系统完全因果连接到淬火事件时出现尖锐的有限跳跃，跳跃幅度由边界g因子比值的对数决定；3) 理论预测与临界Ising链的MPS模拟结果高度吻合；4) 揭示了对称性破缺扰动从边界向系统内部的传播过程。
AI.conclusion: 本工作揭示了边界淬火中通用的动力学特征，建立了非平衡纠缠动力学与边界临界现象之间的直接联系，为理解边界量子系统的非平衡行为提供了重要的理论工具。

title: Bridging distributed quantum materials via multi-hotspot vacuum: remote Cooper pairing and Andreev teleportation
summary: We introduce an architecture where mesoscopic quantum matter distributed over spatially separated nodes can be correlated in equilibrium, creating an unprecedented form of many-body quantum system. Central to the design is a multi-gap split-ring resonator (SRR) where the cavity photon has multiple hot spots -- each with deep-subwavelength volume at a split gap and separated by millimeter-scale distances. The cavity's vacuum fluctuations can then mediate a many-body interaction that bridges the distributed quantum materials embedded in the multiple gaps, coupling them into a single correlated mesoscopic system in equilibrium. As an example, we consider a THz SRR with two split gaps, each proximitized to a metallic moiré superlattice, where virtual exchange of a photon in the cavity vacuum mediates a current-current interaction across the gaps. The inherent attractive interaction channels lead to remote Cooper pairing reminiscent of mesoscopic superconductivity, demonstrated with density matrix renormalization group and exact diagonalization calculations. With the two constituents of a Cooper pair now paired across a millimeter-scale separation, a hole incident at one split gap can be converted into an outgoing electron at the remote gap, a process we term Andreev teleportation. The entanglement entropy between the two mesoscopic superlattices is shown to scale linearly with the area (total number of sites) of the mesoscopic lattice. Our results suggest an intriguing paradigm for equilibrium quantum networks of mesoscopic matter that enable emergent nonlocal functionalities and distributed quantum resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多间隙裂环谐振腔（SRR）的架构，利用腔真空涨落在毫米级空间分离的介质量子物质之间诱导多体相互作用，实现了平衡态下的长程关联与远程库珀配对（Andreev遥传），为平衡态量子网络提供了新范式。
AI.motivation: 现有的量子网络通常依赖非平衡过程（如光子交换）实现远距离量子关联，但如何在平衡态下将空间分离的介质量子系统耦合为一个关联的整体，仍是未解决的问题。作者希望利用腔量子电动力学的真空涨落，实现一种无需外部驱动的内在长程多体关联。
AI.method: 设计多间隙裂环谐振腔（SRR），其腔模在多个分裂间隙处具有深亚波长尺度的热点（hot spots），间隙间相距毫米级。将金属莫尔超晶格嵌入不同间隙，真空光子模式在间隙间诱导电流-电流相互作用，从而远程耦合不同超晶格。使用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）和精确对角化（ED）进行理论计算。
AI.result: 1) 远程库珀配对：两个超晶格之间形成跨越毫米尺度的库珀对，类似介观超导；2) Andreev遥传：入射一个间隙的空穴可在远程间隙转换为出射电子；3) 纠缠熵随介观晶格总面积（总格点数）线性增长，表明长程纠缠。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作展示了平衡态下介质量子网络的可能性，可实现非局域功能（如远程库珀对、Andreev遥传）和分布式量子资源，为平衡态量子网络和介观量子物质的长程关联提供了新范式。

title: Magnetic exchange interactions in the molecular orbital spin system NaV2O5 from a distributed moment point of view
summary: The magnetism in NaV2O5 results from doping of the narrow split-off conduction band of V2O5, which becomes half-filled and leads to a Mott-insulating splitting of spin resolved bands with anti-ferromagnetic order of the spins along the zigzag chains. In the Pmmn structure the spin of this S = 1/2 system is equally shared between two vanadium atoms, residing in a molecular orbital type state. While below 34 K a charge disproportionation occurs into V4+ and V5+, the situation above this temperature is less clear and amounts to a fluctuating moment with equal probability of occupancy of each V. While traditionally described as a quarter-filled ladder system with electron spin localized on the rungs of the ladder, we here take a distributed moment approach in terms of the spin density lumped into individual atomic magnetic sites, including the small induced moments on the oxygen atoms. Exchange interactions are calculated between these sites using a linear response approach based on quasiparticle-self-consistent GW band structures. Surprisingly we find the exchange interactions between the small magnetic moments induced on the vanadyl and bridge oxygen sites to be of the same order of magnitude and even larger than the exchange interactions between vanadium atoms. Their role in the critical temperature is found to be crucial. The spin wave spectra obtained from this classical Heisenberg type Hamiltonian extracted from first-principles contains unusual optic spin wave type collective excitations of high energy.
