AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，揭示了NaV₂O₅中氧原子上的诱导磁矩与钒原子上的磁矩具有同等甚至更大的交换相互作用，对临界温度至关重要，并预测了高能光学自旋波集体激发。
AI.motivation: 传统上NaV₂O₅被描述为四分之一填充的梯子系统，电子自旋局域在梯子横档上。但高温下电荷分布不清晰，存在涨落磁矩。作者试图从分布式磁矩角度重新理解其磁性，特别是氧原子上诱导磁矩的作用。
AI.method: 采用准粒子自洽GW方法（QSGW）计算能带结构，再基于线性响应方法计算各磁性位点（包括V原子及钒氧基/桥氧上的小诱导磁矩）之间的交换相互作用，构建经典海森堡型哈密顿量，进而求解自旋波谱。
AI.result: 发现氧位点上的诱导磁矩之间的交换相互作用与钒原子间的交换相互作用处于同一量级，甚至更大；这些氧位点的交换作用对临界温度起着关键作用；自旋波谱中存在高能光学型集体激发。
AI.conclusion: 氧原子的诱导磁矩在NaV₂O₅的磁性中不可忽略，必须纳入磁性描述中；从第一性原理提取的海森堡哈密顿量能给出包含高能光学支的完整自旋波谱。

title: Double anticrossings induced by nonlinear magnon interactions
summary: We observe pump-induced double anticrossings whose gap sizes and center-frequency shifts depend strongly on pump power, indicating a nonlinear mechanism. The anticrossings vanish at high magnetic fields, where energy conservation suppresses three-magnon splitting, thereby identifying the underlying process as three-magnon scattering. We attribute the double anticrossings to nondegenerate three-magnon splitting, which generates two magnon populations at distinct frequencies. Each population forms a standing-wave mode and couples independently to the Kittel mode, giving rise to two effective coupling channels. These results demonstrate that nonlinear magnon interactions can dynamically generate multiple coupling channels within a single system.

AI.tldr: 本文观察到了泵浦诱导的双重反交叉现象，其能隙大小和中心频率偏移强烈依赖于泵浦功率，表明存在非线性机制。反交叉在高磁场下消失，此时能量守恒抑制了三磁子分裂，从而确定底层过程为三磁子散射。我们将双重反交叉归因于非简并三磁子分裂，它产生了两个不同频率的磁子群体。每个群体形成驻波模式并独立耦合到Kittel模式，形成两个有效耦合通道。这些结果表明非线性磁子相互作用可以动态地在单一系统内生成多个耦合通道。
AI.motivation: 探究磁子非线性相互作用如何产生多重耦合通道，揭示非线性三磁子散射机制在自旋波动力学中的作用。
AI.method: 通过泵浦诱导实验观察双重反交叉现象，分析其能隙和频率偏移对泵浦功率的依赖性，并利用高磁场抑制三磁子分裂来验证机制。
AI.result: 发现双重反交叉由非简并三磁子分裂引起，产生两个不同频率的磁子群体，各自形成驻波模式并独立耦合到Kittel模式，形成双重耦合通道。
AI.conclusion: 非线性磁子相互作用能够在单一系统中动态生成多个耦合通道，为自旋波调控和非线性磁子学提供了新的物理机制。

title: GQD-AdsNet: Graph Neural Networks Unlock Rapid Exploration of Transition Metal Adsorption on Graphene Quantum Dots
summary: In recent years, interest in single-atom catalysts supported on carbon-based structures has grown considerably due to their high catalytic activity and efficient uses of metal atoms. However, the design and characterization of these materials through first-principles calculations are computationally expensive, limiting the exploration of a large number of possible configurations. Here, we developed a framework based on graph neural networks (GNNs) to predict the adsorption energies of transition metals on graphene quantum dots (GQDs). The model was trained using data obtained from density functional theory calculations and achieved an $R^2$ of 0.906 with an MAE of 0.101 eV, while reducing computational cost by roughly six orders of magnitude relative to DFT. This methodology provides an efficient tool for the accelerated screening and rational design of new catalysts based on carbon nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图神经网络（GNN）的框架，用于预测过渡金属在石墨烯量子点（GQDs）上的吸附能，与DFT相比计算成本降低约六个数量级，同时保持高精度（R²=0.906, MAE=0.101 eV），加速了碳纳米结构催化剂的设计与筛选。
AI.motivation: 单原子催化剂在碳基结构上具有高催化活性和金属原子利用率，但通过第一性原理计算来设计和表征这些材料计算成本过高，限制了大量可能构型的探索。
AI.method: 开发了基于图神经网络（GNN）的预测框架，利用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算数据训练模型，预测过渡金属在石墨烯量子点（GQDs）上的吸附能。
AI.result: 模型R²达到0.906，MAE为0.101 eV，计算成本相比DFT降低了约六个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为基于碳纳米结构的新型催化剂加速筛选和理性设计提供了高效工具。

title: Dynamical correlation functions of extensive charges after global quantum quenches
summary: We investigate the $n$-time cumulant generating function (or $n$-Full Counting Statistics, $n$-FCS) of extensive $U(1)$ charges following a quantum quench. Exploiting space-time duality we characterise this function when evolving from initial states that are symmetric under the action of the charge. In particular, we show that if the correlations in time are sufficiently weak, e.g.\ the transport is ballistic, the $n$-FCS factorises into a sum of single-time FCS arranged in a time-shell structure. A direct implication of this structure is a drastic simplification of dynamical correlation functions: in the presence of time ordering they only depend on the smallest time entering the correlator. We support these findings with several analytical and numerical tests performed in free and interacting models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子淬火后U(1)荷的n-时间累积量生成函数（n-FCS）。利用时空对偶性，发现当时间关联足够弱（如弹道输运）时，n-FCS可分解为单时间FCS的"时间壳层"结构，导致动力学关联函数在时间排序下仅依赖于最小时间。通过自由和相互作用模型验证了这一结论。
AI.motivation: 理解量子多体系统淬火后非平衡动力学中电荷涨落的完整统计特性，特别是多时间关联的简化结构。
AI.method: 利用时空对偶性（space-time duality）分析对称初始态下的n-时间累积量生成函数，通过因子化分解揭示时间壳层结构。
AI.result: 当时间关联足够弱时，n-FCS因子化为单时间FCS之和，形成时间壳层结构；时间排序的动力学关联函数仅依赖于最小时间。
AI.conclusion: 建立了量子淬火后电荷涨落的多时间统计与单时间统计之间的简洁关系，为理解非平衡动力学中关联函数的简化提供了新视角。

title: Pure Spin Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in an Altermagnetic Higher-Order Topological Insulator
summary: We investigate the bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) in a $PT$-symmetric two-dimensional heterostructure consisting of a topological insulator coupled to a $d$-wave altermagnet. To describe the symmetry-enforced degenerate bands of this system, we develop a non-Abelian formulation of the spin BPVE, extending the conventional theory from isolated nondegenerate bands to $PT$-degenerate manifolds. We show that the orientation of the Néel vector controls both the topological phase and the character of the nonlinear optical response. When the Néel vector lies in the $xy$-plane, the heterostructure realizes a second-order topological insulator (SOTI) protected by $C_{4z}T$ symmetry. The system also retains $C_{2z}$ symmetry, which completely suppresses second-order charge photocurrents while allowing finite spin photocurrents. As a result, the BPVE becomes an intrinsically pure spin photovoltaic effect, generating a dc spin current without an accompanying charge current. We find that linearly polarized light drives a spin shift current, whereas circularly polarized light generates a spin injection current. Both responses undergo a sign reversal whenever the local Dirac mass changes sign. As the Néel vector is rotated toward the $z$-axis, the SOTI phase transforms into a first-order topological insulating phase, leading to the coexistence of charge and spin photocurrents. Our results establish $PT$-symmetric altermagnetic topological-insulator heterostructures as a versatile platform for generating and controlling pure spin photocurrents and reveal nonlinear spin transport as a sensitive probe of topology and magnetic symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究PT对称二维异质结（拓扑绝缘体耦合d波交变磁体）中的体光伏效应，发展非阿贝尔自旋BPVE理论，发现通过调控奈尔矢量可实现纯自旋光电流（无伴随电荷电流），并建立非线性自旋输运与拓扑相变之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 现有BPVE理论局限于非简并能带，无法处理PT对称系统中受对称性保护的高简并带结构。作者希望拓展理论框架，探索交变磁-拓扑绝缘体异质结中自旋光伏效应的全新机制。
AI.method: 发展非阿贝尔形式的自旋BPVE理论，从孤立非简并能带扩展到PT简并流形；通过奈尔矢量方向调控拓扑相变（SOTI→FOTI）；分别分析线偏振光驱动的自旋移位电流和圆偏振光驱动的自旋注入电流。
AI.result: 奈尔矢量在xy平面时，体系为C4zT对称保护的二阶拓扑绝缘体，C2z对称性完全抑制电荷光电流但允许自旋光电流，实现纯自旋光伏效应；线偏振光产生自旋移位电流，圆偏振光产生自旋注入电流，两者随局域狄拉克质量变号而反转；奈尔矢量转向z轴时，SOTI转变为一阶拓扑绝缘体，出现电荷与自旋光电流共存。
AI.conclusion: PT对称交变磁-拓扑绝缘体异质结为产生和调控纯自旋光电流提供了多功能平台，非线性自旋输运可作为探测拓扑相和磁对称性的灵敏探针。

title: Symmetry-protected cubic-touching topological surface bands with tunable singularities
summary: We propose a class of topological surface bands in three-dimensional topological crystalline insulators that have symmetry-protected cubic-order band touching. Within the symmetry constraint, the band dispersion can continuously vary between cubic dispersion, moat band and multi-mini-valley structure with van Hove singularities by adjusting particle-hole asymmetry and anisotropy. Thus, there is a family of tunable density-of-state singularities ranging from power-law to logarithmic divergences. This offrs a versatile platform for engineering strongly correlated phases of matter in topological surface states. We provide an example realization in a prism-lattice tight-binding model of angular-momentum-3/2 electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类三维拓扑晶体绝缘体中的拓扑表面带，这些表面带具有对称性保护的三次能带接触点。通过调节粒子-空穴不对称性和各向异性，能带色散可在三次色散、护城河带和多谷结构（含van Hove奇点）之间连续变化，从而产生一系列从幂律到对数发散的密度态奇点，为拓扑表面态中强关联相的工程化提供了多功能平台。
AI.motivation: 寻找拓扑表面态中可调谐的密度态奇点，以实现强关联电子相的工程化调控。
AI.method: 理论提出了一类具有对称性保护的三次能带接触点的拓扑表面带，通过调节粒子-空穴不对称性和各向异性实现能带色散的连续变化，并用角动量3/2电子的棱镜晶格格点模型进行了示例实现。
AI.result: 发现能带色散可在三次色散、护城河带和多谷结构之间连续变化，产生从幂律到对数发散的多种密度态奇点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为利用拓扑表面态的可调谐密度态奇点来工程化设计强关联电子相提供了通用平台。

title: Multiscale ensemble Monte Carlo of transport and gas sensing in monolayer MoS$_2$
summary: Two-dimensional semiconductors, such as monolayer MoS$_2$, combine a technologically useful band gap with an all-surface geometry, making them attractive both as field-effect-transistor channels and as chemically sensitive devices. Predictive device design requires a transport model that is (i) physically grounded rather than empirical, (ii) validated against experiments, and (iii) able to span the scales from electron-phonon coupling to terminal current and sensor response. We present a self-consistent ensemble Monte Carlo (EMC) framework for monolayer MoS$_2$ built on the ViennaEMC solver, comprising a Boltzmann-transport kernel with a full intrinsic and extrinsic scattering stack (deformation-potential acoustic and intervalley phonons, polar-optical Fröhlich and piezoelectric coupling, remote substrate phonons, screened charged-impurity and surface-roughness scattering), degenerate free-carrier statistics, and a self-consistent Poisson coupling. The intrinsic transport parameters are verified against first-principles density-functional perturbation theory (DFPT), and seven quantities (lattice constant, conduction-band effective mass, band gap, Born effective charges, the longitudinal-optical phonon energy, and both in-plane sound velocities) agree with the reference parametrization. In a multiscale coupling, the EMC velocity-field characteristic feeds a one-dimensional velocity-saturation channel model, which captures the velocity-saturated field dependence and reproduces the measured transfer characteristics of a CVD monolayer device in air and vacuum. Finally, an ambient/adsorbate extension reproduces the measured conductivity response to oxygen partial pressure and the concentration dependence of NO$_2$ and NH$_3$ sensing measured in several independent devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自洽的系综蒙特卡洛（EMC）框架，用于单层MoS₂的输运建模，该框架基于物理机理、经第一性原理和实验验证，能跨尺度从电子-声子耦合到器件电流和传感器响应，并成功复现了CVD器件的转移特性及对O₂、NO₂、NH₃的气敏响应。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体（如单层MoS₂）兼具技术上有用的带隙和全表面几何结构，在FET通道和化学敏感器件中极具潜力。然而，预测性器件设计需要一个物理基础扎实、经实验验证且能跨尺度（从电子-声子耦合到终端电流和传感器响应）的输运模型，现有研究尚缺乏这样统一且自洽的框架。
AI.method: 基于ViennaEMC求解器构建自洽的系综蒙特卡洛（EMC）框架，包含玻尔兹曼输运内核、完整的内禀和外禀散射机制（形变势声学声子、谷间声子、极化和压电耦合、远程衬底声子、屏蔽库仑杂质和表面粗糙度散射）、简并载流子统计及自洽泊松耦合。内禀参数经DFPT验证，EMC速度-场特性耦合到一维速度饱和沟道模型，并扩展至环境/吸附物模型用于气敏模拟。
AI.result: 七个关键内禀参量（晶格常数、导带有效质量、带隙、玻恩有效电荷、纵光学声子能量、两个面内声速）与参考值一致；模型成功复现了CVD单层器件在空气和真空中的转移特性；环境/吸附物扩展模型复现了O₂分压下的电导响应以及NO₂和NH₃传感的浓度依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 该EMC框架为单层MoS₂提供了从微观散射到宏观器件性能的统一输运模型，兼具物理基础、实验验证性和多尺度扩展能力，为二维半导体器件和传感器的预测性设计奠定了工具基础。

title: Data-driven Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks with Tunable Negative Thermal Expansion
summary: Materials with negative thermal expansion (NTE) are essential for applications requiring precise control of thermal expansion. Owing to their exceptional chemical tunability, flexible architectures, and low-energy lattice vibrations, metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) represent a rich platform for exploring NTE. However, uncovering the structural motifs that govern NTE across the enormous MOF design space remains experimentally challenging, and large-scale first-principles phonon calculations are computationally prohibitive. Here, we comprehensively evaluate the factors influencing NTE in MOFs by utilizing a high-throughput workflow based on MACE-MP-MOF0, a machine learning interatomic potential fine-tuned for MOFs with near-ab initio accuracy, to construct PhononMOFdb, a database of phonons, inelastic neutron scattering spectra, bulk moduli, and heat capacities for over 12,000 MOFs. High-throughput screening of this database reveals that highly porous cubic topology frameworks with heavier, lower-valent metal nodes favor strong NTE, while linker functionalization provides a practical handle for tuning NTE magnitude and sign without compromising mechanical stability. Experimental validation via high-resolution temperature-dependent synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction on the Ce-UiO-66 MOF and its brominated variants confirms the design recipe and yields volumetric NTE coefficients surpassing current records. This work establishes a data-driven strategy for engineering NTE in MOFs, showing how machine learning-accelerated discovery and targeted experimental validation together unlock predictive materials design.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习势函数MACE-MP-MOF0构建了包含12,000多种MOF的声子数据库PhononMOFdb，通过高通量筛选揭示了影响负热膨胀（NTE）的关键结构因素，并通过实验验证了Ce-UiO-66及其溴化变体的优异NTE性能，提出了数据驱动的NTE工程策略。
AI.motivation: 负热膨胀材料在精密热膨胀控制应用中至关重要，MOF因其化学可调性和柔性结构成为探索NTE的理想平台，但缺乏高效的大规模筛选方法来揭示其结构-性能关系。
AI.method: 采用MACE-MP-MOF0机器学习原子间势（精度接近第一性原理），构建PhononMOFdb数据库，包含振动声子、非弹性中子散射谱、体积模量和热容；通过高通量筛选和实验验证（同步辐射粉末X射线衍射）相结合的方法。
AI.result: 高孔隙率立方拓扑骨架、重且低价金属节点有利于强NTE；配体官能化可在不牺牲机械稳定性的条件下调控NTE大小和符号；Ce-UiO-66及其溴化变体的体积NTE系数超越了现有记录。
AI.conclusion: 建立了数据驱动的MOF负热膨胀工程策略，证明了机器学习加速发现与针对性实验验证相结合能够实现预测性材料设计。

title: Statistical properties of quadrangular surfaces
summary: We investigate the statistical properties of random quadrangular surfaces generated by different randomization procedures: the Gruzberg-Klümper-Nuding-Sedrakyan (GKNS) construction, and two newly introduced generalizations of dynamical triangulations (DT), dynamical (DQ) and general quadrangulations (GQ). We formulate these surfaces within a unified graph-theoretic framework and establish the relationships between the elementary operations defining the different ensembles. For GKNS surfaces, we demonstrate that the construction is equivalent to two mutually constrained percolation processes and determine the associated critical point and critical exponents, revealing deviations from ordinary percolation. For DQ and GQ, we analyze the underlying Markov chains and determine the scaling of mixing and relaxation times. We further analyze all three ensembles through their degree distributions, degree correlations, distance statistics, and Hausdorff dimensions. While DQ exhibits exponentially decaying degree distributions and geometric properties similar to DT, GKNS and GQ display broad, scale-free degree distributions. Moreover, GKNS surfaces possess an asymptotic Hausdorff dimension $Δ_H\approx 2$, whereas DQ and GQ approach $Δ_H\approx 4$, similarly to DT. This indicates that DQ is compatible with the universal behavior of DT, while GKNS and GQ define distinct classes of random geometry, implying a different underlying measure in the space of random surfaces and a possible geometric framework for a new class of noncritical string theories.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了三种随机四边形曲面构造（GKNS、DQ、GQ）的统计性质，发现DQ与标准动态三角剖分（DT）表现出普适类行为，而GKNS和GQ则呈现出无标度度分布和不同的豪斯多夫维度，定义了新的随机几何类别，可能为新型非临界弦理论提供几何框架。
AI.motivation: 探索不同随机化程序生成的四边形曲面的统计性质，理解它们是否属于相同的普适类，并揭示新的随机几何结构。
AI.method: 建立统一的图论框架，将GKNS构造等价为两个相互约束的逾渗过程；对DQ和GQ分析其马尔可夫链的混合时间与松弛时间；通过度分布、度相关性、距离统计和豪斯多夫维度全面比较三种系综。
AI.result: GKNS与GQ展现出宽尾/无标度度分布；DQ度分布指数衰减；GKNS的豪斯多夫维度Δ_H≈2，而DQ和GQ≈4；GKNS的临界指数偏离普通逾渗；DQ与DT普适类一致。
AI.conclusion: DQ与DT属于同一普适类，而GKNS和GQ定义了新的随机几何类别，暗示随机曲面空间中不同的测度，可能支撑新型非临界弦理论。

title: Photon Correlation Spectroscopy as a Probe of Critical Fluctuations in Correlated Electron Systems
summary: Characterizing phase transitions between correlated electronic phases, extracting their critical exponents, and identifying their universality class are of central interest in many-body physics. Here, we propose and demonstrate that photon correlation spectroscopy can be used to gain insight into the nature of critical electronic density fluctuations. We study a semiconductor moiré material consisting of two MoSe2 layers separated by a monolayer h-BN spacer and measure interlayer electron dynamics via the second-order correlation function of the scattered photons. The correlated transfer of large numbers of electrons between the layers at the onset of an Ising-type layer pseudo-spin phase transition leads to photon bunching in light scattered by the exciton resonance of one layer. Our measurements pave the way for using photon correlations as a method to access dynamical exponents associated with electronic phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并证明，光子关联光谱学可用于研究临界电子密度涨落的性质。通过测量半导体莫尔材料中两层MoSe₂之间电子转移的光子二阶关联函数，在Ising型层赝自旋相变开始时观察到光子聚束效应，为利用光子关联方法获取电子相变的动力学指数铺平了道路。
AI.motivation: 表征关联电子相之间的相变、提取临界指数并识别其普适类是多体物理学的核心问题。现有方法对此类临界行为的探测存在局限，亟需新的实验手段。
AI.method: 使用光子关联光谱学，研究由单层h-BN隔开的两层MoSe₂构成的半导体莫尔材料，通过测量散射光子二阶关联函数探测层间电子动力学。
AI.result: 在Ising型层赝自旋相变开始时，大量电子在层间发生关联转移，导致其中一层激子共振散射的光子出现聚束效应。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为利用光子关联方法获取电子相变相关的动力学指数开辟了新途径。

title: Alchemical thermodynamic integration for ab initio free-energy calculations in solutions
summary: We develop an alchemical thermodynamic integration scheme that couples ab initio force calculators on the fly during Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations. The implementation is validated against existing hybrid-Hamiltonian approaches. The scheme yields ab initio free energies of high-pressure Fe-Ni and ambient Li-Na liquid solutions that agree with previous calculations and reproduce the experimentally observed Li-Na miscibility gap. The code has an efficiency comparable to standard ab initio molecular dynamics. These results establish this scheme as a practical alchemical-integration framework for first-principles free-energy calculations in solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于从头算力计算器的热力学积分方案，可在蒙特卡洛和分子动力学模拟中实时耦合，用于计算溶液的自由能，并在Fe-Ni和Li-Na液体溶液中验证了其准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 为了在从头算（第一性原理）水平上高效且准确地计算溶液的自由能，弥补现有混合哈密顿方法的不足，提出一种实用的化学积分框架。
AI.method: 开发了一种热力学积分方案，在蒙特卡洛和分子动力学模拟过程中实时耦合从头算力计算器，实现化学积分（alchemical thermodynamic integration）。
AI.result: 该方案计算的高压Fe-Ni和常温Li-Na液体溶液的自由能与先前计算结果一致，并成功复现了Li-Na的混溶间隙实验观察结果；计算效率与标准从头算分子动力学相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方案被确立为一种实用的、基于第一性原理的溶液自由能化学积分框架。

title: Phase equilibria in MnSb2Te4-GeSb2Te4 system and magnetic properties of Mn1-xGexSb2Te4 solid solutions
summary: As a sister compound of the antiferromagnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4, MnSb2Te4 is also a candidate for exotic magnetic topological phases. On the other hand, the structurally analogous but nonmagnetic phase-change material GeSb2Te4 is also known to exhibit nontrivial band topology. Motivated by their shared crystal structure, the similar ionic radii of Mn2+ and Ge2+, and the opportunity to explore the interplay between magnetism and topology, here we investigate the effects of Ge substitution at Mn sites in MnSb2Te4. The Mn1-xGexSb2Te4 solid solutions were synthesized via high-temperature solid-state reaction and characterized for composition, structure, phase behavior, and magnetism using SEM-EDS, PXRD, DTA, and SQUID. Ge substitution was successful across the full composition range, producing homogeneous, single-phase samples that melt via peritectic reactions, as confirmed by the MnSb2Te4GeS-b2Te4 phase diagram. Ge substitution strengthens the sample's paramagnetism, but with ferrimagnetic ordering up to x = 0.75, with both effective moment and saturation magnetization decreasing with increasing Ge content. Two distinct magnetic transitions - high-temperature paramagnetic to ferrimagnetic and low-temperature ferrimagnetic to ferromagnetic - were identified, with a dome-like shape dependence of the low-temperature magnetic transition on Ge substitution. A negative magnetization was observed in the pristine MnSb2Te4 and x = 0.12 substituted samples, while two distinct spin-flop transitions appeared in the samples with x = 0.32 and x = 0.55 Ge substitutions as a result of competing magnetic orderings. These findings facilitate future selective single-crystal growth of homogeneous, magnetic phases, paving the way for magneto-transport and topological surface states investigations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了MnSb2Te4中Mn位被Ge取代形成的Mn1-xGexSb2Te4固溶体，涵盖全组分范围的合成、结构表征和磁性分析，发现Ge取代增强顺磁性、降低磁有序温度并引发多样的磁相变行为。
AI.motivation: MnSb2Te4与GeSb2Te4具有相同晶体结构，且Mn2+与Ge2+离子半径相似，这为探索磁性与拓扑的相互作用提供了契机。通过Ge取代Mn，研究者希望调控磁有序，为未来拓扑表面态和磁输运研究奠定基础。
AI.method: 采用高温固相反应合成Mn1-xGexSb2Te4全组分固溶体，利用SEM-EDS、PXRD、DTA和SQUID对其组成、结构、相行为和磁性进行系统表征。
AI.result: Ge可在全组分范围内成功取代Mn，形成均一单相样品。Ge取代增强顺磁性，但铁磁有序维持至x=0.75；有效磁矩和饱和磁化强度随Ge含量增加而降低。观测到两个磁相变（高温顺磁→亚铁磁、低温亚铁磁→铁磁），低温磁相变呈穹顶状依赖Ge含量。纯MnSb2Te4和低取代样品出现负磁化，而中取代样品出现两个不同的自旋-flop转变。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为未来选择性生长均匀磁性单晶提供了指导，有助于推动磁输运和拓扑表面态的研究。

title: Electrostatic Control Enables Robust Helical Edge Channel Transport in III-V Quantum Spin Hall Insulators
summary: Quantum spin Hall transport in InAs/GaInSb-based two-dimensional topological insulators can be limited by parasitic bulk and edge contributions. We demonstrate that these limitations are effectively mitigated through electrostatic control in dual-gated InAs/GaInSb/InAs trilayer quantum wells grown on AlSb quasi-substrates. In macroscopic Hall bars exceeding the phase coherence length, a multi-probe analysis reveals an insulating bulk and a constant edge resistance over a wide electric-field range. In microscopic devices with edge lengths below the phase coherence lengths, the edge resistance remains robust and quantized accross a broad field range, revealing the intrinsic resilience of helical edge channels to electric-field perturbations. Only beyond a threshold value, parasitic edge contributions emerge. These results establish dual gating as a reliable strategy to suppress parasitic conduction while stabilizing helical edge transport, providing a versatile and reproducible platform for tunable topological transport in III-V quantum spin Hall systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了InAs/GaInSb基二维拓扑绝缘体中的量子自旋霍尔输运，发现双栅极控制可以有效抑制寄生体态和边缘贡献，在宏观和微观器件中均实现鲁棒的边缘输运，为III-V族量子自旋霍尔系统提供了可调谐的平台。
AI.motivation: 量子自旋霍尔输运受到寄生体态和边缘贡献的限制，亟需有效手段来抑制这些不利因素，以实现纯净的边缘态输运。
AI.method: 采用双栅极结构对生长在AlSb准衬底上的InAs/GaInSb/InAs三层量子阱进行静电调控，在宏观和微观霍尔巴器件中进行多探针输运测量。
AI.result: 宏观器件中观察到绝缘体态和恒定边缘电阻；微观器件中边缘电阻在宽电场范围内保持鲁棒且量子化，仅超过阈值后才出现寄生边缘贡献。
AI.conclusion: 双栅极调控是抑制寄生传导、稳定螺旋边缘输运的可靠策略，为III-V族量子自旋霍尔系统提供了可重复、可调谐的平台。

title: Stereochemical Vacuum Gap Explains Out-of-Plane Thermal Insulation in MXenes
summary: Two-dimensional MXenes are promising materials for thermal management and spectral camouflage, combining low out-of-plane thermal conductivity with low infrared emissivity and mechanical robustness. Yet the near-order-of-magnitude spread in experimental out-of-plane thermal conductivity measurements (0.14-0.8 W/mK) and the systematic overestimation by simulations point to a fundamental gap in our understanding of heat transport in these materials. Here, we argue these differences originate in the overlooked role of heterogeneous surface terminations. Using Non-Equilibrium Molecular Dynamics simulations of Ti3C2Tx, we show that this discrepancy arises from a stereochemically induced vacuum gap between adjacent layers, formed when surface terminations of different sizes coexist. Even minor deviations from homogeneous terminations drastically suppress out-of-plane thermal conductivity, bringing simulated values into quantitative agreement with experiment. We also show that thermal conductivity scales strongly with the atomic density, and that introducing bulky surface terminations, including residual water, reduces the thermal conductivity to 0.3 W/mK, an order of magnitude below homogeneous termination values and below the minimum thermal conductivity limit predicted for disordered solids. Thus, we propose a chemistry-driven route to engineer thermal transport in MXenes.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了MXene材料面外热导率实验与模拟差异的根本原因——异质表面官能团引发的立体真空层。通过分子动力学模拟证明，不同尺寸表面官能团共存时会产生真空间隙，显著抑制热传导，使模拟值首次与实验定量吻合，并据此提出化学调控热输运的新路径。
AI.motivation: 实验测量的MXene面外热导率存在近一个数量级的差异（0.14-0.8 W/mK），且模拟结果系统性高估，说明对这类材料热输运机制的理解存在根本性缺失。
AI.method: 采用非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）模拟，对Ti3C2Tx体系研究不同表面官能团（如-O、-OH、-F及残余水分子）的组合对层间热传导的影响，分析原子密度与立体构型的关系。
AI.result: 异质表面官能团产生立体真空层，即使轻微的非均匀性也会大幅抑制面外热导率；热导率与原子密度强相关；引入大尺寸官能团（含残余水）可将热导率降至0.3 W/mK，低于无序固体的理论最小热导率极限。
AI.conclusion: 提出化学驱动的热输运工程策略，通过调控表面官能团组成来精确设计MXene的导热性能，弥合了理论与实验的鸿沟。

title: Magnonic crystalline properties of stripe textures in thin ferromagnetic films
summary: Ordered stripe domains in ferromagnetic thin films form a natural one-dimensional crystal for propagating spin waves. Their spatial periodicity can be tuned readily with an applied magnetic field, making these systems an attractive platform for exploring how magnon band structures evolve as a function of the lattice constant $a$, a tuning that is difficult to achieve in physically patterned materials. In this work we employ micromagnetic simulations to calculate the spin-wave spectra of a model iron-garnet film, focusing on the influence of the external field and of cubic anisotropy. We find that band gaps at the Brillouin-zone center ($k = 0$) and at the zone boundary ($k = \pm π/a$) respond differently to the applied field, appearing over a broad range of frequencies and wave vectors. When a perpendicular magnetic field or cubic anisotropy is present, additional gaps can appear at the middle of the reduced Brillouin zone ($k = \pm π/2a$). This behavior is interpreted as a Peierls-type distortion of the domain-wall lattice, wherein ``up'' and ``down'' domains alternately expand and contract under the influence of the effective perpendicular field.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微磁模拟研究了铁石榴石薄膜中条纹畴结构的自旋波谱，揭示了能带隙随外场和立方各向异性的变化规律，并观察到类似Peierls畸变的畴壁晶格扭曲现象。
AI.motivation: 条纹畴结构形成天然的一维自旋波晶体，其空间周期可通过外磁场灵活调控，这种在物理图案化材料中难以实现的晶格常数调谐为探索磁振子能带结构演化提供了理想平台。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟方法计算模型铁石榴石薄膜的自旋波谱，系统研究外磁场和立方各向异性对能带结构的影响。
AI.result: 布里渊区中心($k=0$)和区边界($k=±π/a$)的带隙对外加场响应不同；当存在垂直磁场或立方各向异性时，约化布里渊区中点($k=±π/2a$)出现额外带隙。
AI.conclusion: 观察到的能带行为可解释为畴壁晶格的Peierls型畸变——"上"和"下"畴在有效垂直场作用下交替膨胀和收缩。

title: Sixteen-State Energy Mapping for First-Principles Four-Spin Ring Exchange: Validation on $La_2CuO_4$ and $SrFeO_2$
summary: Four-spin ring (cyclic) exchange $J_{ring}$ is an essential ingredient of the Heisenberg spin Hamiltonian of cuprates and other square-lattice magnets, yet it has lacked the kind of direct, local first-principles extraction that the four-state method provides for bilinear exchange, $J$. We supply it by generalizing that method to a sixteen-state ($2^4$) scheme. Symmetry reduces the sixteen configurations to six or eight inequivalent energies, so the cost is modest. The derivation also shows that the conventional four-state magnetic coupling, $J$, is itself ring-renormalized, by $\pm 2 J_{ring} S^2$ with the sign set by the reference state. T-La$_2$CuO$_4$ confirms this quantitatively: three independent routes agree on $J_{ring}$ to $0.2\%$, giving $J_{ring}/J_1 = 0.25$, and a four-state $J_1$ quoted without naming its reference is wrong by $12\%$ in this material. The direct sixteen-state extraction itself proves reference-dependent, the Néel and ferromagnetic baths bracketing the mapping value: a fourth-order fingerprint of interactions beyond the pair-plus-ring model, which additional reference baths resolve into a bare $J_{ring}$ and a converging tower of six- and eight-spin loop couplings. SrFeO$_2$ ($S = 2$), with the same plaquette yet $J_{ring}/J = 0.006$, provides the negative control: a plaquette is necessary for ring exchange, far from sufficient. The complete workflow, including the band-gap and local-moment diagnostics that certify any such extraction, is implemented in the openly available Mag4 package, so that $J_{ring}$ costs no more effort to obtain than $J$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种十六态（2⁴）第一性原理方案，直接从晶格模型中提取四自旋环交换耦合J_ring，并证明传统四态方法提取的J实际上已被J_ring重整化。在T-La₂CuO₄中验证了J_ring/J₁=0.25，而忽略此效应的J₁误差达12%。SrFeO₂作为负对照显示，仅具有plaquette结构远不足以产生显著的环交换。该工作已集成到开源Mag4软件包中。
AI.motivation: 环交换J_ring是铜氧化物等方晶格海森堡模型的关键成分，但此前缺乏像四态方法提取双线性交换J那样的直接、局域的第一性原理提取方法。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将传统的四态（2²）方法推广至十六态（2⁴）方案，利用对称性将16种构型简化为6或8种不等价能量，从而以较低计算成本提取J_ring。同时分析了参考态对提取结果的影响，并引入能隙和局域矩诊断来确保提取的有效性。
AI.result: 1) 传统四态方法提取的J本身被J_ring重整化（±2J_ring S²），符号取决于参考态；2) 在T-La₂CuO₄中三条独立路径获得一致的J_ring（误差0.2%），J_ring/J₁=0.25，忽略此效应时J₁误差达12%；3) 十六态提取本身也具有参考态依赖性，需通过多种参考浴解析出裸J_ring及更高阶自旋环耦合；4) SrFeO₂中J_ring/J=0.006，表明plaquette是必要条件但远非充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种与四态方法同样简便的J_ring第一性原理提取方案，揭示了环交换对传统双线性耦合测量值的重要影响，并已开源实现，使得环交换的获取不再比双线性交换更困难。

title: Quantized heat flow in moiré chern bands of bilayer graphene
summary: When electrons are subjected simultaneously to a magnetic field and a periodic potential, they form the fractal Hofstadter spectrum, whose topological gaps host quantum Hall and Chern insulating states with distinct Chern numbers. While electrical transport has established the topology of these states, whether their heat transport is likewise universal has remained unexplored. Here, we measure the thermal conductance of quantum Hall, Chern insulator, and interaction-driven symmetry-broken Chern insulator states in a bilayer graphene-hexagonal boron nitride moiré superlattice with a moirè wavelength of $\sim$14 nm using Johnson-noise thermometry. We find that the thermal conductance ($G_Q$) is quantized in units of the thermal conductance quantum ($G_Q = tκ_0T$) and is determined solely by the Chern number ($t$), independent of the microscopic origin of the topological state. By directly revealing universal topological heat transport in Hofstadter bands, our work establishes thermal conductance as a stringent probe of moiré topological matter and provides a route to investigating more exotic phases, including fractional Chern insulators.

AI.tldr: 本文通过约翰逊噪声测温法，测量了双层石墨烯-六方氮化硼莫尔超晶格中量子霍尔、陈绝缘体和相互作用驱动的对称性破缺陈绝缘体态的热导，发现热导以热导量子为单位量子化，仅由陈数决定，与拓扑态的微观起源无关，直接揭示了霍夫施塔特带中通用的拓扑热输运。
AI.motivation: 电输运已确立了霍夫施塔特分形谱中拓扑态的拓扑性质，但热输运是否同样具有普适性尚未被探索。
AI.method: 使用约翰逊噪声测温法，测量双层石墨烯-六方氮化硼莫尔超晶格（莫尔波长约14 nm）中不同拓扑态的热导。
AI.result: 热导G_Q以热导量子κ₀T为单位量子化，其值仅由陈数t决定，与拓扑态的微观起源（量子霍尔、陈绝缘体或对称性破缺态）无关。
AI.conclusion: 热导是探测莫尔拓扑物质的严格探针，揭示了霍夫施塔特带中通用的拓扑热输运，并为研究分数陈绝缘体等更奇异物相提供了途径。

title: Deciphering Mechanoluminescence: How the Nature of Mechanical Stress and Structural Dimensionality Shape Mechanisms and Responses
summary: Mechanoluminescent materials exhibit a broad spectrum of controllable light-emission responses to mechanical stimuli of varying types and magnitudes. Yet progress toward high-performance systems remains constrained by an incomplete and often contradictory mechanistic understanding. Here, density functional theory (DFT) calculations optimized for the quantitative treatment of point defects are used to systematically investigate the interplay between stress type (hydrostatic vs. shear) and active-phase dimensionality (1D vs. 3D), using $SrAl_2O_4:Eu^{2+}, Dy^{3+}$ and $Ba_4Si_6O_{16}:Eu^{2+}, Ho^{3+}$ as representative model systems. Two distinct emission-driving mechanisms are identified: a piezoelectric contribution, and a second, apparently universal, mechanism arising from stress-induced structural reorganization at point defects sites. These results establish a design framework for mechanoluminescent materials in which crystal dimensionality, stress type and stress-sensitive point defects are deliberately matched to tune emission behavior and overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT计算，系统研究了力致发光材料中应力类型（静水压vs剪切）与活性相维度（1D vs 3D）的相互作用，识别出压电效应和应力诱导缺陷结构重组两种发光驱动机制，并建立了维度-应力-缺陷匹配的设计框架。
AI.motivation: 力致发光材料进展受限于对机理的不完整且矛盾的理解，需系统探究应力类型与材料维度对发光性能的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用针对点缺陷定量处理优化的DFT计算，以SrAl2O4:Eu2+,Dy3+和Ba4Si6O16:Eu2+,Ho3+为模型体系，系统研究应力类型（静水压vs剪切）与活性相维度（1D vs 3D）的相互作用。
AI.result: 识别出两种不同的发光驱动机制：压电贡献机制，以及第二种普遍存在的应力诱导点缺陷结构重组机制。
AI.conclusion: 建立了力致发光材料的设计框架：通过有意匹配晶体维度、应力类型和应力敏感点缺陷，可调控发光行为和整体性能。

title: Complete Hierarchy of Nonrelativistic Odd-Parity Spin Splitting in Collinear Magnets
summary: Momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting provides a symmetry fingerprint of collinear magnets and can govern unconventional electronic, magnonic, and transport phenomena. Whereas even-parity $s$-, $d$-, $g$-, and $i$-wave splittings in collinear magnets have been extensively studied, odd-parity counterparts remain unexplored beyond the $p$-wave and $f$-wave classes. Here, using group theory, we establish the complete classification of odd-parity spin splitting in collinear magnets. We show that, in addition to the $p$-wave and $f$-wave forms, $h$- and $k$-wave splittings with $\ell=5$ and $7$ are allowed, while $m$-wave splitting with $\ell=9$ constitutes the upper bound. We derive a complete mapping from crystallographic point-group irreducible representations to the lowest-order odd-parity basis functions and formulate the coupling rule between a symmetry-breaking axial field and the parent Néel order that selects the induced odd-parity class. We further construct minimal lattice models that realize $h$-, $k$-, and $m$-wave splitting. Guided by this classification, we screen the MAGNDATA database and show that circularly polarized light can drive the $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric antiferromagnets Fe$_2$TeO$_6$ and MgFe$_6$Ge$_6$ into $h$-wave and $k$-wave phases, respectively, exhibiting the hallmark spin splittings in both electronic bands and magnon spectra. Symmetry analysis and Berry-curvature calculations show that collinear odd-parity magnets of both $h$- and $k$-wave allow an anomalous Hall response, whereas the $m$-wave class forbids it. Together, these results complete the partial-wave hierarchy of odd-parity spin splitting in collinear magnets and establish symmetry criteria for anomalous transport in the high-partial-wave classes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用群论完成了共线磁体中奇宇称自旋劈裂的完整分类，揭示了$h$波($\ell=5$)、$k$波($\ell=7$)和$m$波($\ell=9$)等高阶分波形式，并建立了从晶体点群不可约表示到奇宇称基函数的完整映射。通过对称性分析和贝里曲率计算，发现$h$波和$k$波体系允许反常霍尔响应，而$m$波则禁止。
AI.motivation: 共线磁体中偶宇称自旋劈裂（$s$、$d$、$g$、$i$波）已被广泛研究，但奇宇称自旋劈裂除了$p$波和$f$波外尚未被系统探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立完整的奇宇称自旋劈裂分类体系。
AI.method: 采用群论方法，从晶体点群不可约表示出发，推导奇宇称基函数并建立完整分类；构建最小晶格模型实现$h$、$k$、$m$波自旋劈裂；通过MAGNDATA数据库筛选候选材料；利用对称性分析和贝里曲率计算验证输运性质。
AI.result: 发现了$h$波($\ell=5$)、$k$波($\ell=7$)和$m$波($\ell=9$)三种新的奇宇称自旋劈裂形式，其中$m$波为上限；识别出Fe$_2$TeO$_6$和MgFe$_6$Ge$_6$两种可通过圆偏振光驱动实现$h$波和$k$波相的材料；证明了$h$和$k$波允许反常霍尔效应，而$m$波禁止。
AI.conclusion: 完成了共线磁体中奇宇称自旋劈裂的完整分波层级，为高阶分波类中的反常输运建立了对称性判据，对理解非常规电子、磁振子和输运现象具有指导意义。

title: Doping tunable charge density waves in misfit layer compounds
summary: The ability to tune charge density waves (CDWs) through external control knobs, such as doping, pressure or strain is crucial for exploring the phase diagram of two dimensional (2D) or quasi-2D materials. Yet, controlling CDWs critical temperature and ordering vector remains a challenge for current experimental techniques. In this work, we establish misfit layer compound heterostructures as a reliable platform to manipulate CDWs in transition metal dichalcogenides. By combining ab initio calculations with low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy, we show how to achieve doping tunable control over NbSe2 CDW by chemically alloying in the rocksalt subunit. Crucially, we prove that tuning the La Pb ratio in the misfit family (LaxPb1xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2 enables stabilization of different CDW orders, such as 2x2 or 3x3 patterns, and even coexisting phases. This work paves the way for engineering transition metal dichalcogenides with tailored charge density waves within misfit heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用 misfit 异质结（(LaₓPb₁₋ₓSe)₁.₁₄(NbSe₂)₂）通过化学合金化调控 La/Pb 比例，实现对 NbSe₂ 中电荷密度波（CDW）的掺杂可调控制，能够稳定 2×2、3×3 等不同 CDW 序甚至共存相。
AI.motivation: 当前实验技术难以有效调控二维/准二维材料中电荷密度波的临界温度和有序矢量，亟需一种可靠平台来实现对 CDW 的人为操控。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算结合低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM），在 misfit 层状异质结 (LaₓPb₁₋ₓSe)₁.₁₄(NbSe₂)₂ 中通过改变 La/Pb 化学配比进行掺杂调控。
AI.result: 成功证明通过调节 La/Pb 比例，可以选择性地稳定 NbSe₂ 中不同的 CDW 有序（如 2×2、3×3 图案），甚至实现 CDW 共存相。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了 misfit 异质结作为一种可靠平台，为在过渡金属硫族化合物中工程化具有定制电荷密度波的材料铺平了道路。

title: Thermal and electrical conductivity of a refractory high-entropy alloy after high-pressure torsion: Electron versus phonon contributions
summary: The equiatomic refractory high-entropy alloy TiZrHfNbTa was processed by high-pressure torsion (HPT) to investigate the effect of nanostructuring and defect engineering on thermal and electrical transport properties. Severe plastic deformation (SPD) via the HPT treatment induces substantial accumulation of dislocations, grain refinement to the nanometer level (average: 40 nm), and partial transformation from the BCC phase to the omega phase. While hardness increases to a steady state with processing, the specific heat capacity exhibits a non-monotonic behavior: it decreases at low strains due to the suppression of low-frequency vibrational modes by dislocations, then partially recovers at high strains due to anharmonic vibrations at newly formed high-angle grain boundaries. Thermal conductivity decreases at low strains but shows a slight recovery at high strains, whereas electrical conductivity decreases monotonically to a steady state without recovery. Analysis using the Wiedemann-Franz law reveals that the electronic contribution dominates thermal transport, while the phononic contribution (limited by the scattering of phonons on defects) is only 11 to 23%, depending on the degree of straining. The contrasting evolution of thermal and electrical conductivity is ascribed to the transition from dislocation-dominated vibrations at low strains to grain boundary-dominated vibrations at high strains, which affects phonons and electrons with different efficiencies.

AI.tldr: 通过高压扭转（HPT）对TiZrHfNbTa难熔高熵合金进行纳米结构化和缺陷工程处理，研究了其对热和电输运性质的影响。HPT引入位错、晶粒细化至40 nm及部分ω相变。热容和热导率呈非单调变化（低位错抑制低频振动，高应变下高角晶界恢复），电导率单调下降。电子贡献主导热传输，声子贡献仅11-23%。热、电导率差异源于位错向晶界主导的振动转变对不同载流子的不同影响。
AI.motivation: 探究纳米结构化和缺陷工程对难熔高熵合金TiZrHfNbTa热、电输运性质的影响，揭示微观结构演化与输运性能之间的关联机制。
AI.method: 采用高压扭转（HPT）对等原子比TiZrHfNbTa进行严重塑性变形（SPD），通过改变应变程度调控缺陷结构（位错、晶界）和相变（BCC→ω相），并利用Wiedemann-Franz定律分离电子和声子对热导率的贡献。
AI.result: 1) HPT导致位错积累、晶粒细化至~40 nm、部分BCC→ω相变；2) 硬度随加工趋于稳态；3) 热容非单调变化（低位错抑制低频振动→降低；高应变高角晶界非谐振动→恢复）；4) 热导率先降后微升，电导率单调下降至稳态；5) 电子贡献主导热传输，声子贡献仅11-23%。
AI.conclusion: 热、电导率的差异演化归因于低应变下位错主导振动向高应变下晶界主导振动的转变，这种转变对声子和电子的散射效率不同。电子导热占主导，声子导热受缺陷散射严重限制。

title: Spatially resolved in-situ characterisation of competing martensitic transformation pathways during nanoscratch in 316H Stainless Steel
summary: Localised surface deformation beneath frictional contacts generates a tribolayer whose microstructure and properties differ from the bulk. In austenitic stainless steels, this tribolayer forms through two competing martensitic transformation pathways. Here, these pathways are isolated in 316H stainless steel using in-situ synchrotron X-ray nanodiffractometry combined with nanoscratch testing, which together yield spatial maps of the evolving strain field beneath a single sliding asperity. Finite element modelling interprets the resulting distribution of martensitic phases, revealing a pressure driven pathway selection where hydrostatic compression ahead of the contact suppresses $α'$ formation and favours the $γ\rightarrow \varepsilon$ transformation, while lateral sliding relieves this constraint and introduces a shear strain driving $\varepsilon \rightarrow α'$ , producing an overall sequential $γ\rightarrow \varepsilon \rightarrow α'$ pathway in the tribolayer. Where hydrostatic constraint persists, $\varepsilon$-martensite is retained; where material piles up and is unconstrained above the surface, the transformation proceeds directly to $α'$. The $γ$-austenite adjacent to $α'$- martensite shows elevated dislocation density, indicating that $α'$ formation is accommodated by plastic deformation in the surrounding matrix. This distinction could explain differences in galling performance among iron-based and cobalt-based hardfacing alloys, where the $\varepsilon$-martensite forming cobalt alloys offer superior galling resistance. The methodology presented resolves transient microstructural states inaccessible to static measurements of macroscale, multiple asperity contacts, establishing a route to mechanistic insight across tribological phenomena more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过原位同步辐射X射线纳米衍射与纳米划痕实验，揭示了316H不锈钢在摩擦接触下马氏体相变的压力驱动路径选择机制：接触前方静水压缩抑制α'相形成并促进γ→ε转变，侧向滑动释放约束后剪切应变驱动ε→α'转变，从而形成γ→ε→α'的序列路径。该发现解释了钴基合金（形成ε马氏体）比铁基合金（直接形成α'马氏体）具有更优抗磨损性能的原因。
AI.motivation: 摩擦接触下的表面变形会形成微观结构与性能不同于基体的摩擦层。在奥氏体不锈钢中，摩擦层通过两种竞争性马氏体相变路径形成，但微观机制尚不清楚。现有宏观多接触点静态测量无法解析这些瞬态微观结构状态，因此需要高分辨率原位表征手段来揭示单个滑动接触下的相变路径选择机制。
AI.method: 采用原位同步辐射X射线纳米衍射技术结合纳米划痕实验，在316H不锈钢中获取单个滑动接触下应变场的空间分布图。同时利用有限元建模解释马氏体相的空间分布，分析压力驱动的路径选择机制。
AI.result: 揭示了摩擦层中γ→ε→α'的序列相变路径：接触前方静水压缩抑制α'形成并促进ε马氏体生成；侧向滑动释放约束后剪切应变驱动ε向α'转变。在静水约束持续的区域，ε马氏体被保留；在材料堆积且无约束的表面区域，相变直接进行到α'。α'马氏体附近的γ奥氏体显示出高位错密度。

title: Time-resolved ARPES in pumped excitonic systems: Floquet physics induced by excitonic fields
summary: We develop a theoretical framework based on the Dynamical Projective Operatorial Approach (DPOA) to study the time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (TR-ARPES) of pumped excitonic systems. Including Coulomb electron-electron interactions at the Hartree-Fock (HF) level, our formalism captures the formation of excitonic bound states under the application of pump pulses. Considering a prototypical two-dimensional two-band semiconductor, we analyze the equilibrium phase diagram, which shows the expected transition from a semiconducting to an excitonic-insulator phase as the Coulomb interaction strength or its range increase. Out of equilibrium, we find that when the pump frequency is resonant with an excitonic mode, coherent oscillations of the excitonic order parameter persist after the pump pulse subsides and give rise to clear Floquet sidebands in the TR-ARPES spectrum. These exciton-field-induced sidebands are distinct from those originating from the pump laser field. We also identify band-resonance-induced sidebands arising from residual coherences at momenta where the band gap is resonant with the pump frequency. Finally, we analyze the local Coulomb interaction limit. Our results corroborate recent experimental observations of exciton-field-induced Floquet-like sidebands and establish DPOA as an efficient and accurate method for simulating ultrafast phenomena in interacting electron systems.
